In a world where words travel faster than thought, protecting free speech without enabling harm may be one of the defining tests of modern democracy.

t: What central conflict is explored in the passage?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पूरे पैसेज का मुख्य विषय "आज़ादी (Freedom)" और "ऑनलाइन नुकसान (online harm, hate speech, misinformation)" के बीच संतुलन बनाने की बहस (pressing debate) है।

t: Why is regulation of speech on social media controversial?
o: It is illegal in all democracies
It gives too much power to users
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज में साफ लिखा है: "others fear it might lead to suppression of dissent" (कुछ लोगों को डर है कि नियमों से असहमति/विरोध की आवाज़ों को दबाया जा सकता है)। 'Dissent' का अर्थ है असहमति।

t: What is the concern about private companies controlling speech?
o: They are too small to influence politics
They lack legal authority or accountability
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज चिंता जताता है कि "private companies-not elected bodies-decide..." यानी ये कंपनियाँ जनता द्वारा चुनी हुई (elected) नहीं हैं, इसलिए उनके पास ऐसा करने का लोकतांत्रिक या कानूनी अधिकार/जवाबदेही (accountability) नहीं है।

t: According to the author, what is required to resolve this conflict?
o: Combining rights with safety through law and literacy
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: लेखक के अनुसार सही संतुलन के लिए "thoughtful policies, digital literacy, and legal frameworks" (सोची-समझी नीतियां, डिजिटल साक्षरता और कानूनी ढांचे) की ज़रूरत है।

t: What tone does the author adopt in the passage?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: लेखक ने दोनों पक्षों (फ्री स्पीच के फायदे और नुकसान) को बिना किसी पक्षपात के पेश किया है और समाधान पर 'विचार' (reflect) किया है। इसलिए यह टोन 'संतुलित और विचारशील' (Balanced and reflective) है।

p: In today's technology-centric era, electronic devices have become indispensable to modern life. From smartphones and laptops to home appliances, the demand for newer and faster gadgets continues to escalate. However, this increasing dependence has brought about a critical challenge — electronic waste, commonly known as e-waste. E-waste refers to discarded electrical or electronic equipment that is obsolete or non-functional. Unlike regular waste, it contains hazardous substances such as lead, mercury, and cadmium. Improper disposal of e-waste allows these toxins to seep into soil and water bodies, causing severe environmental degradation and posing long-term health risks. Developing nations are particularly vulnerable, as they often receive large volumes of e-waste from wealthier countries. In many cases, informal recycling sectors handle this waste without adequate safety measures. Workers, including children, dismantle devices manually, exposing themselves to toxic chemicals and dangerous working conditions. On the brighter side, responsible recycling of e-waste enables the recovery of valuable materials like copper, gold, and high-quality plastics. This not only mitigates environmental harm but also reduces the strain on natural resources. Governments and environmental agencies are advocating for sustainable practices such as repairing old devices, donating functional electronics, and following safe recycling methods. Public awareness, coupled with stringent regulations, is vital for tackling this escalating problem. In conclusion, managing e-waste effectively demands both individual accountability and collective efforts. Adopting eco-friendly habits can lead us toward a cleaner, safer, and more sustainable future.

t: Identify the type of the following sentence: "Improper disposal of e-waste allows these toxins to seep into soil and water bodies, causing severe environmental degradation and posing long-term health risks."
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: इस वाक्य में केवल एक ही Independent Clause (Improper disposal... allows...) है। "causing" और "posing" Participle phrase हैं, कोई Clause नहीं। इसलिए यह Simple Sentence है।

t: Transform the above assertive sentence into an interrogative sentence: "Electronic devices have become indispensable to modern life."
o: Why electronic devices have become indispensable to modern life?
Had electronic devices have become indispensable to modern life?
Are electronic devices become indispensable to modern life?
Have electronic devices become indispensable to modern life?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: 'Have become' (Present Perfect) को Interrogative बनाने के लिए Auxiliary verb 'Have' को Subject (electronic devices) के आगे रखा जाता है।

t: What is the most appropriate meaning of the word "obsolete" as used in the passage?
o: Outdated and no longer in use
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Obsolete" का अर्थ है 'पुराना पड़ जाना' या जिसका अब इस्तेमाल न होता हो (Outdated)। Hindi Meaning: अप्रचलित / पुराना.

t: Which word is closest in meaning to "mitigate" as used in the sentence: "This not only mitigates environmental harm but also reduces the strain on natural resources."
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Mitigates" का अर्थ होता है कम करना (reduce)। इसलिए "Lessens" (कम करना) इसका सटीक Synonym है।

t: Why are developing countries more vulnerable to the dangers of e-waste, according to the passage?
o: They produce the most e-waste in the world.
They often receive large volumes of e-waste and lack proper safety measures.
Their citizens prefer using outdated electronic devices.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज बताता है कि विकासशील देश असुरक्षित हैं क्योंकि: "they often receive large volumes of e-waste from wealthier countries" और वहाँ "without adequate safety measures" रिसाइक्लिंग होती है।

p: Feminism has made a journey through three principal waves, each one of them being shaped by the historical setting and the dominant social issues of that time. The first wave, which took place in the late 19th and early 20th centuries, was primarily concerned with obtaining basic rights for women, such as the right to vote. Prominent leaders such as Susan B. Anthony advocated for political equality, representing a significant advancement in the movement for women's empowerment.

The second wave, during the 1960s and 1970s, broadened the movement to address workplace equality, reproductive rights, and sexual autonomy. Influential figures such as Betty Friedan questioned traditional gender roles and advocated for both societal and institutional reforms.

The third wave, beginning in the 1990s, worked to include more people by fixing problems from earlier movements, which often left out women of color, LGBTQ+ people, and women from working-class backgrounds. This stage focused on how different parts of a person's identity, like race, class, and gender, affect their experiences. Each stage of feminism shows how the movement has changed and keeps working for equal rights for all genders.

t: Which of the following best describes the focus of the first wave of feminism?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: प्रथम लहर (19वीं सदी के अंत/20वीं के आरंभ) का केंद्र मताधिकार जैसे बुनियादी अधिकार और राजनीतिक समानता था।

t: What were the main issues that became important during the second wave of feminism?
o: Voting rights and property ownership for women
Changing political systems to include women in political affairs
Equality at work, reproductive rights, and sexual autonomy
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: दूसरी लहर (1960-70 का दशक) ने कार्यस्थल समानता, प्रजनन अधिकार और यौन स्वायत्तता के मुद्दे उठाए।

t: In what ways did feminism shift in focus and impact during each of its three waves?
o: It kept a single focus on women's suffrage and political equality all the time
Its attention moved to work and reproductive rights, thus limiting its range of interest as time passed
It was exclusively concerned with economic reforms and neglected to address cultural discrimination at the same time
It changed from legal matters to cultural, social, and identity-related matters as society evolved
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: तीनों लहरों में आंदोलन कानूनी मुद्दों से सांस्कृतिक, सामाजिक और पहचान-आधारित मुद्दों की ओर बढ़ा।

t: The third wave of feminism focused on:
o: Its primary focus was on laws pertaining to women's property rights and marriage
Women's rights were advanced in the workplace, and gender norms were dismantled
A greater emphasis on intersectionality and the involvement of more varied voices
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: तीसरी लहर (1990 के दशक से) ने अंतर्विभागीयता (intersectionality) और अधिक विविध आवाज़ों की भागीदारी पर ज़ोर दिया।

t: Which leader and contribution are correctly matched with the wave of feminism?
o: Betty Friedan - Challenged predefined gender roles during the second wave of feminism
Susan B. Anthony - Advocated for women's rights in the administrative space
Betty Friedan - Focused intersectionality and inclusivity in the third wave of feminism
Susan B. Anthony - Advocated on voting rights and political equality in the first wave of feminism
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज में स्पष्ट जोड़ी: सुसान बी. एंथनी, पहली लहर में मताधिकार और राजनीतिक समानता की पक्षधर; इसलिए (d) सही है।

p: Once relegated to the peripheries of legitimate professional discourse, YouTube content creation has metamorphosed into a formidable and highly nuanced career avenue. Far beyond the superficial glitz of viral videos, contemporary content creators must navigate a labyrinthine ecosystem encompassing algorithmic unpredictability, audience analytics, intellectual property considerations, and brand partnership intricacies. The platform's democratized nature ostensibly offers an egalitarian promise anyone with a camera and an idea can, theoretically, ascend to prominence. However, the reality is far more Darwinian. Success on YouTube today demands not only creative ingenuity but also a keen acumen in digital marketing, search engine optimization (SEO), and an ever-evolving understanding of platform-specific trends. Consistency in output, meticulous engagement with viewer communities, and adaptability to sudden policy shifts have become indispensable skills. Moreover, the psychological ramifications of tethering one's livelihood to fluctuating view counts and algorithmic favor should not be underestimated. Burnout, imposter syndrome, and a precarious sense of self-worth plague many full-time creators. Unlike traditional careers, YouTube offers no institutional safety nets; creators must independently negotiate contracts, secure health benefits, and plan for financial volatility. Nonetheless, for those who can master this digital alchemy, the rewards are substantial both financially and creatively. The platform enables unparalleled autonomy, offering a direct conduit between creator and audience, unmediated by corporate gatekeepers. In an era increasingly defined by the decentralization of media, YouTube content creation is not merely a trend but a harbinger of the future of work. "The platform enables unparalleled autonomy, offering a direct conduit between creator and audience, unmediated by corporate gatekeepers."

t: Identify the grammatical function of the phrase "offering a direct conduit between creator and audience" in the sentence:
o: Present participial phrase functioning as an adverb
Noun phrase acting as an object
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Offering a direct conduit between creator and audience" की शुरुआत present participle "offering" (-ing) से होती है, इसलिए यह Participial Phrase है। यह मुख्य clause को modify करता है और बताता है कि platform ने कैसे या किस नतीजे के साथ असाधारण autonomy दी, इसलिए यह adverb की तरह काम करता है। उत्तर (b) Present participial phrase functioning as an adverb।

t: In the sentence "Far beyond the superficial glitz of viral videos, contemporary content creators must navigate a labyrinthine ecosystem encompassing algorithmic unpredictability..." What is the function of the introductory phrase "Far beyond the superficial glitz of viral videos"?
o: Prepositional phrase functioning as a noun
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Far beyond the superficial glitz of viral videos" एक Prepositional Phrase है जो दिशा/स्थान जैसा adverbial काम करता है। यह main verb "navigate" के लिए संदर्भ (metaphorical location) बनाता है, यानी creators को viral videos की चमक-दमक से कहीं आगे जाकर रास्ता बनाना पड़ता है। इसलिए (b) Adverbial phrase modifying "navigate" सही है।

t: What is the closest meaning of the word "labyrinthine" as used in the passage?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Labyrinthine" शब्द labyrinth (भूलभुलैया) से बना है। इस संदर्भ में यह YouTube के इकोसिस्टम को बहुत उलझा हुआ, अप्रत्याशित और भ्रमित करने वाला बताता है, जिसमें creators को रास्ता खोजना पड़ता है। इसलिए (b) Mysterious and confusingly complex सही है। Hindi Meaning: भूलभुलैया जैसा / जटिल।

t: Choose the most appropriate antonym for the word "harbinger" as used in the last line of the passage.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Harbinger" वह व्यक्ति या चीज़ है जो किसी के आने की सूचना दे, यानी अग्रदूत/precursor। इसके विकल्पों में Catalyst, Precursor और Omen इसी के क़रीब हैं। विपरीतार्थक वह होगा जो बाद में आए, यानी "Successor" (उत्तराधिकारी)। इसलिए (c) सही है। Hindi Meaning: अग्रदूत / पूर्व-सूचक; Antonym: उत्तराधिकारी।

t: Which of the following best captures the primary tension described in the passage?
o: The tension between traditional media and decentralized platforms
The tension between the glamorized perception of content creation and its actual challenges
The tension between corporate sponsorships and independent artistry
The tension between financial rewards and creative compromises
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज बार-बार YouTube के "egalitarian promise" और "superficial glitz" को उसकी "Darwinian" (कड़े संघर्ष वाली) हकीकत से तुलना करता है, और algorithm की अनिश्चितता, burnout, आर्थिक अस्थिरता जैसी चुनौतियाँ बताता है। इसलिए मुख्य टकराव content creation की चमकदार छवि और उसकी असली चुनौतियों के बीच है। उत्तर (b)।

p: One of the biggest ethical dilemmas of the twenty-first century is brought up by the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into modern combat, particularly in the form of autonomous weapons systems (AWS). The promise of strategic advantage is pitted against fundamental ethical principles in the fiercely debated issue of whether or not such "killer robots" should be allowed in combat. Supporters contend that autonomous weapons might decrease the loss of human life, since they do not fear, become tired, or suffer the emotional stress that can cause human mistakes in combat. They also might be able to operate with more accuracy and rapidity in an unpredictable environment, which could decrease civilian casualties. The ethical arguments are serious, nonetheless. The most compelling argument is the transfer of the life-and-death decision-making from a human to a machine. Opponents contend that a computer, however sophisticated, could never have the moral calculus, compassion, or comprehension of human dignity to make such judgments. This creates an important question of accountability: in the event that an autonomous weapon kills without authorisation, who has the moral and legal culpability? Is it the programmer who wrote the algorithm, the commander who sent the system out, or the state that legitimised its use? The secrecy of AI's decision-making process, commonly known as a "black box," also adds to the difficulty in assigning blame. This built-in absence of clear moral and legal norms tests the very foundations of the international laws of armed conflict. Essentially, the debate about autonomous weapons puts us in a position of considering not only the technology but also human responsibility, judgment, and the ethical limits we are prepared to place on the waging of war.

t: Which of the following is the most compelling ethical argument against autonomous weapons in combat?
o: The potential for increased civilian casualties
The speed at which autonomous weapons operate
The transfer of life-and-death decision-making to machines
The lack of accountability in AI decisions
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज साफ़ कहता है: "The most compelling argument is the transfer of the life-and-death decision-making from a human to a machine."

t: According to the passage, what is the primary concern regarding the integration of AI into modern warfare?
o: The technology will never be able to operate in war zones
Autonomous weapons may lack the moral responsibility to make life-and-death decisions
It would be illegal under international laws of armed conflict
AI could be hacked and used against states
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: विरोधियों का मानना है कि कंप्यूटर में कभी भी इंसानों जैसी "moral calculus, compassion" (नैतिक ज़िम्मेदारी) नहीं हो सकती जो जीवन-मृत्यु का फैसला ले सके।

t: In the passage, the term "moral calculus" refers to:
o: The ability to make ethical decisions
The efficiency of AI systems in combat
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Moral calculus" का अर्थ है सही और गलत के बीच फर्क करने की 'नैतिक निर्णय लेने की क्षमता' (ability to make ethical decisions)।

t: What is the primary ethical concern raised by the "black box" nature of AI decision-making in AWS?
o: It increases the speed of decision-making
It makes it difficult to assign moral and legal culpability
It reduces the potential for civilian casualties
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: AI के 'Black Box' (जिसमें पता न चले कि फैसला कैसे लिया गया) होने से यह तय करना मुश्किल हो जाता है कि गलती होने पर सज़ा किसे दी जाए (assigning blame / culpability)।

t: Which argument in favor of autonomous weapons is most strongly supported by proponents?
o: They can create more humane warfare
They ensure that no human is ever at risk in combat
They act with more accuracy and rapidity
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: समर्थक (Proponents) यह तर्क देते हैं कि ये हथियार ज़्यादा सटीक होते हैं "which could decrease civilian casualties" (जिससे निर्दोष नागरिकों की मौतें कम हो सकती हैं )।

p: The Kite Runner is a story of love, faith, loss, betrayal, guilt, and redemption written by the Afghan-American writer Khaled Hosseini and first published in 2003. Though honest, it is a painful story, and that pain stems from a cowardly and cruel act committed in childhood. Ahint of the author's own childhood can be studied in his writing. Like Amir, he left Afghanistan as a child and returned only as an adult. The novel is a work of historical fiction and drama; it depicts the political and social landscape of then-contemporary Afghanistan. Themes of betrayal, love, family relations, discrimination, and violence prevail throughout the book. What inspired Hosseini to write this novel is the cruelty of the Taliban inflicted on the people of Afghanistan. Hosseini grew up flying kites in Kabul, but when he heard that the Taliban had banned the activity of flying kites, and that's how he came up with The Kite Runner. The novel beautifully depicts two different lives that coexist yet are so different from each other. The divide between the high class and the low class, the oppression of the minority community by the majority community. It is a story about "to be good again" and overcoming evil despite adverse circumstances. The idea is to atone for past sins and make the necessary sacrifice to redeem yourself.

t: What is the central driving force behind the redemption arc in the novel?
q.sr: [SSC Stenographer Grade C & D Examination, 2026, 11 sep 2026, Shift-1]
o: The protagonist's attempt to atone for a cowardly and cruel act from his childhood.
The author wants to record the history of kite-flying competitions in Kabul.
The government orders the removal of class divisions between different social groups.
The need to get financial compensation for losses suffered during the Taliban era.
q.e: The passage explicitly states that the core idea driving the story is "to atone for past sins" stemming directly from a "cowardly and cruel act committed in childhood", thus forming the protagonist's profound redemption arc.

t: According to the passage, what specific event sparked Khaled Hosseini's inspiration for the title and central motif of the book?
o: Returning to Afghanistan as an adult after living in America.
Hearing that the Taliban had banned the activity of flying kites in Kabul.
Witnessing the discrimination between the high and low social classes.
Discovering historical records about the political landscape of Afghanistan.
q.e: The text directly outlines the author's inspiration, stating clearly that "when he heard that the Taliban had banned the activity of flying kites, and that's how he came up with The Kite Runner."

t: How does the passage describe the socio-political context depicted in the novel?
o: As a utopian landscape where class divides do not exist.
As a purely fictional account with no relation to the real-world political landscapes of Afghanistan.
As a depiction of the political and social landscape of then-contemporary Afghanistan.
As an economic study of the trade relations between Afghanistan and the U.S.
q.e: The passage unequivocally confirms the novel's deeply rooted real-world setting, stating that as a work of historical fiction, "it depicts the political and social landscape of then-contemporary Afghanistan."

t: What can be inferred about the protagonist's relationship with his homeland?
o: He never left his country, even during the Taliban's rule.
He returned to Afghanistan to fight the Taliban government.
He remained in a high-class society throughout the war and didn't care about political turmoil.
He shares a parallel with the author, having left as a child and returning as an adult.
q.e: By pointing out that "A hint of the author's own childhood can be studied in his writing," and immediately following with "Like Amir, he left Afghanistan as a child and returned only as an adult," the passage draws a direct parallel between them.

t: In the passage, the word "atone" is used. Which of the following words acts as a synonym for "atone" in this context?
q.e: The verb "atone" means to make heavy amends or rigorous reparation for a deeply regretted past mistake or terrible sin. "Expiate" is a highly formal synonym meaning to make amends for guilt or wrongdoing, matching the exact religious and moral context.

p: When a child is surrounded by a universe of faithful and multifaceted objects, he can just see himself as the possessor. As a consumer, never as a maker, he does not create the universe. He applies it: actions are there, sometimes even in a very boring way, open for him, no adventure, no wonder, no joy. The child controls the whole situation as if he were a little stay-at-home householder; he does not even have to invent the mainsprings of adult causality, they are supplied to him ready-made: he just has to take, he never is allowed to find something out by himself from beginning to end. Even the simplest set of blocks, as long as it is not too subtle, suggests a very different learning of the world: the child who plays with the blocks does not in any way produce meaningful objects; the adult's name does not matter at all; the actions he does are those of a user, but he is a maker of gods. He makes forms that walk, that roll, he creates life, not property: the objects now have their own will; they are no longer a dead and complicated material lying in his hand.

t: What central contrast does the passage draw regarding the child's relationship with objects?
o: One child love playing outside, while the other is kept inside
One educated child who is able to read comics and picture books, and one untrained child who is barely able to speak
Rich kids with lots of toys and poor kids with limited resources
One kid gets the attention of the designers by just playing with the toys, while the other one enjoys creating things
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज दो बच्चों की तुलना करता है: एक जो तैयार खिलौनों का केवल उपभोक्ता है और दूसरा जो ब्लॉक्स से कुछ रचता है (maker)।

t: According to the passage, why are pre-manufactured toys considered limiting to a child's development?
o: They are so flimsy and break before meaningful play can happen
Possesses no competition when pitted against digital devices for the child's attention
Are now past and irrelevant, weighing on the historical scale
Carry out actions that leave no room for discovery, imagination, or invention
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: तैयार खिलौने ऐसी क्रियाएँ पहले से देते हैं, इसलिए बच्चे को खोज, कल्पना और आविष्कार का अवसर नहीं मिलता।

t: What does the author suggest the child give up when he becomes a "little stay-at-home householder"?
o: His need for social interaction with peers
His innate capacity for imaginative exploration
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: 'little stay-at-home householder' बनने पर बच्चा कल्पनाशील अन्वेषण की अपनी सहज क्षमता खो देता है।

t: What is the rationale behind the author's appreciation for a child's engagement with simple blocks?
o: By facilitating the teaching of math and logic in a more effective way, the students, therefore, are able to integrate their learning into everyday situations
By enabling the kids to play in the adults' world since their tools are so similar, adults have passed on their skills to the kids.
By making the kid reliant on the adult, thus slowly making him/her ready to face society without fear or judgment
By permitting the child to empower shapes and express ideas through imagination rather than possession
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: सरल ब्लॉक्स बच्चे को कल्पना से रूप गढ़ने और विचार व्यक्त करने देते हैं, स्वामित्व के बजाय रचनात्मकता के साथ।

t: What critique of consumer culture is embedded in the author's discussion of the child as "possessor"?
o: That children lack the maturity to grasp the economic systems
That parents should never buy toys for their children at all.
That child's nature is to be materialistic, and correction is needed
That abundance of possessions makes children value ownership over creation
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: लेखक की आलोचना: वस्तुओं की अधिकता बच्चों में रचने के बजाय स्वामित्व (ownership) को महत्व देना सिखाती है।

p: Metals are often associated with industrial use and construction, but many of them play a vital role in the human body and are essential for maintaining good health. These bio-essential metals, present in small quantities, are involved in crucial physiological functions such as oxygen transport, enzyme activity, and immune response. Iron, for instance, is a key component of hemoglobin, the protein in red blood cells that carries oxygen throughout the body. A deficiency in iron can lead to anemia, fatigue, and reduced cognitive function. Zinc supports the immune system, aids in wound healing, and is necessary for proper growth and development, especially in children. Calcium, though more commonly known as a mineral, is technically a metal. It is essential for strong bones and teeth, and also plays a role in muscle contraction and nerve transmission. Similarly, magnesium contributes to over 300 enzyme reactions in the body and supports muscle and nerve function. Copper aids in the formation of red blood cells and supports cardiovascular health, while selenium, a trace metal, functions as an antioxidant, protecting cells from damage. However, it is important to note that while these metals are beneficial in small amounts, excessive intake either through supplements or environmental exposure can be toxic. Maintaining a balanced diet rich in fruits, vegetables, whole grains, and lean proteins typically provides sufficient amounts of these essential metals.
Understanding their role highlights the intricate connection between nutrition, chemistry, and overall health.

t: Choose the correct negative interrogative form of the following sentence: "It is essential for strong bones and teeth, and also plays a role in muscle contraction and nerve transmission."
o: It isn't essential for strong bones and teeth, and also plays a role in muscle contraction and nerve transmission.
It should not be essential for strong bones and teeth, and also plays a role in muscle contraction and nerve transmission.
Shouldn't it be essential for strong bones and teeth, and also plays a role in muscle contraction and nerve transmission.
Isn't it essential for strong bones and teeth, and doesn't it play a role in muscle contraction and nerve transmission?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: वाक्य में दो clauses और दो verbs हैं: "is" और "plays"। दोनों को negative interrogative में बदलना होगा: "Isn't it ...?" और "doesn't it play ...?" Option (d) दोनों को सही बदलता है, जबकि (a) और (b) सिर्फ़ एक clause बदलते हैं। उत्तर (d)।

t: Choose the correct interrogative form of the following sentence: "Copper aids in the formation of red blood cells."
o: Do copper aid in the formation of red blood cells?
Is copper aiding in the formation of red blood cells?
Does copper aid in the formation of red blood cells?
Has copper aided in the formation of red blood cells?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Aids" Simple Present singular है (copper singular है)। Yes/No प्रश्न "Does" + base verb से बनता है: "Does copper aid ...?" Option (a) में "Do" singular के लिए ग़लत है, (b) Present Continuous बना देता है और (d) Present Perfect। Trick: Singular subject + Does + V1। उत्तर (c)।

t: Read the line from the passage and answer the question: "Maintaining a balanced diet rich in fruits, vegetables, whole grains, and lean proteins typically provides sufficient amounts of these essential metals." Which of the following is the most appropriate antonym for "sufficient" as used above?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Sufficient" का अर्थ है पर्याप्त। इसका antonym "Inadequate" है, यानी जो ज़रूरत पूरी न करे। "Abundant" का मतलब ज़रूरत से ज़्यादा और "Excessive" का मतलब बहुत अधिक है, ये दूसरी दिशा के शब्द हैं, सीधे antonym नहीं। उत्तर (a) Inadequate। Hindi Meaning: पर्याप्त; Antonym: अपर्याप्त।

t: Which idiom best describes the importance of consuming essential metals in the right amounts, as highlighted in the passage?
o: A stitch in time saves nine
Too much of a good thing
Every cloud has a silver lining
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज चेतावनी देता है कि trace metals ज़रूरी हैं, पर ज़्यादा मात्रा विषैली हो सकती है। "Too much of a good thing" इसे सही पकड़ता है, यानी अच्छी चीज़ भी ज़्यादा हो तो नुकसान करती है। "A bitter pill to swallow" का अर्थ अप्रिय बात मानना और "A stitch in time saves nine" का अर्थ समय पर काम करना है, जो यहाँ नहीं बैठते। उत्तर (c)।

t: What is the role of iron in the human body as described in the passage?
o: It helps in the formation of hemoglobin which transports oxygen
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज के अनुसार iron "a key component of hemoglobin, the protein in red blood cells that carries oxygen throughout the body" है। यानी iron hemoglobin बनाने में मदद करता है जो ऑक्सीजन ढोता है। Calcium हड्डियों को, magnesium मांसपेशियों को और selenium कोशिकाओं को सुरक्षा देता है। उत्तर (d)।

p: Group thinking, often referred to as groupthink, is a psychological phenomenon wherein the desire for unanimity within a group overrides the motivation to appraise alternative viewpoints critically. It frequently leads to flawed decision-making because dissent is either internally suppressed or socially penalized. Social conformity, its close ally, describes the act of aligning one's beliefs or behaviours with those of a majority, often subconsciously, in pursuit of acceptance or avoidance of conflict. In tightly knit groups — such as corporate boards, political committees, or academic panels — individual members may refrain from expressing contrarian ideas, fearing ostracization or reputational risk. Over time, this collective homogeneity breeds intellectual stagnation, reducing innovation and enhancing vulnerability to strategic errors. The infamous Bay of Pigs invasion and the Challenger space shuttle disaster are frequently cited as textbook examples of decisions marred by groupthink. Psychologically, the roots of group conformity lie in our evolutionary inclination toward tribal belonging, where deviation was historically associated with survival risk. In modern society, the same instinct manifests through peer pressure, organizational culture, and digital echo chambers. Algorithms reinforce conformity by curating information bubbles that validate existing biases while filtering out divergent thought. However, the remedy to such cognitive myopia lies in institutionalizing dissent. Constructive disagreement, when encouraged within teams or communities, acts as an intellectual safeguard against tunnel vision. Promoting a culture where counterarguments are respected rather than reprimanded can lead to more robust, balanced, and resilient decision-making. In an age dominated by viral trends, polarized discourse, and performative alignment, the courage to question consensus is both rare and essential. True progress emerges not from blind allegiance to majority norms, but from critical inquiry and the audacity to challenge the comfortable.

t: What is the central idea of groupthink as discussed in the passage?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Groupthink का मुख्य विचार यही है कि लोग आलोचना (critique) करने के बजाय आपस में 'सहमति' (unanimity / consensus) बनाए रखने को ज़्यादा अहमियत देते हैं।

t: According to the passage, what evolutionary trait contributes to social conformity?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज कहता है कि हमारी यह आदत हमारे पूर्वजों से आई है: "evolutionary inclination toward tribal belonging, where deviation was historically associated with survival risk." (कबीले के साथ रहना सर्वाइवल के लिए ज़रूरी था)।

t: Which event is cited as a real-world consequence of groupthink?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज में ग्रुपथिंक के दो उदाहरण दिए गए हैं: "The infamous Bay of Pigs invasion and the Challenger space shuttle disaster."

t: How does digital media reinforce conformity, according to the passage?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: डिजिटल मीडिया के बारे में लिखा है: "Algorithms reinforce conformity by curating information bubbles..." जिन्हें 'echo chambers' भी कहा जाता है, जहाँ हमें सिर्फ अपनी पसंद की बातें सुनाई देती हैं।

t: What is suggested as a solution to groupthink and conformity?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: इसका समाधान (remedy) है: "institutionalizing dissent. Constructive disagreement, when encouraged..." (रचनात्मक असहमति को बढ़ावा देना)।

p: In today's digital age, convenience often comes at the cost of privacy. Every time a user browses a website, clicks a link, or uses an app, their data is collected-sometimes without their knowledge. Companies use this information to target ads, predict behavior, or even sell insights to third parties. While this can lead to better services, it also raises ethical concerns. Who controls this data? How is it stored, and can users truly opt out? Many people accept terms and conditions without reading them, unknowingly giving permission for data tracking. Some countries have passed laws to protect user data, but implementation remains weak. As surveillance tools grow smarter, the line between public and private becomes blurred. Individuals must now learn to balance the benefits of technology with the right to privacy-a task that requires awareness, regulation, and responsible digital behavior.

t: According to the passage, how is user data often collected?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज में साफ लिखा है: "their data is collected-sometimes without their knowledge" और लोग "unknowingly giving permission" (अनजाने में अनुमति दे देते हैं)।

t: What does the passage say about laws protecting data?
o: They are strict in all countries
They exist but are poorly enforced
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Some countries have passed laws... but implementation remains weak." (कानून तो हैं, लेकिन उनका लागू होना/एनफोर्समेंट बहुत कमज़ोर है)।

t: What is one positive use of user data mentioned in the passage?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: डेटा के इस्तेमाल का एक फायदा पैसेज में बताया गया है: "While this can lead to better services..." (यह बेहतर सेवाएं प्रदान कर सकता है)।

t: What does the author suggest is needed to protect privacy?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: अंतिम लाइन में लिखा है: "a task that requires awareness, regulation, and responsible digital behavior."

p: Old age is often described as a period of reflection, wisdom, and sometimes, unexpected emotional turbulence. Many elderly people experience a complex mix of emotions, ranging from contentment and gratitude to loneliness and anxiety. While some find comfort in family bonds and cherished memories, others struggle with feelings of neglect and isolation, especially when their social circle diminishes or their health declines. Experts suggest that emotional wellbeing in old age largely depends on supportive relationships and a sense of purpose. Engaging in hobbies, maintaining friendships, and feeling valued by younger generations can significantly uplift an elderly person's mood and outlook on life. Sadly, in many societies, older individuals are not given the attention and respect they deserve, which can intensify their feelings of despair. Younger generations should respect older individuals. It is, therefore, essential for families and communities to acknowledge the emotional needs of the elderly and create an environment where they feel heard, respected, and loved. A society that cares for its older generation ultimately safeguards its own humanity.

t: Identify the tense of the verb "is described" in the first sentence.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Is described" में 'is' (Simple Present) के साथ Verb की Third Form 'described' लगी है, जो कि Passive Voice की पहचान है (बुढ़ापे को दर्शाया 'जाता है')।

t: Choose the option that correctly converts this sentence into passive voice: "Younger generations should respect older individuals."
o: Older individuals are respected by younger generations.
Older individuals should be respected by younger generations.
Older individuals have been respected by younger generations.
Older individuals must respected by younger generations.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: 'Should respect' (Modal Active) पैसिव में 'should be respected' बन जाता है। Object 'Older individuals' आगे आ जाएगा।

t: What does the word "neglect" most nearly mean as used in the passage?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Neglect" (उपेक्षा करना / ध्यान न देना) का अर्थ है किसी को नज़रअंदाज़ करना। इसका सबसे करीबी समानार्थी (Synonym) 'Disregard' है। बाकी (Support, Care) इसके विलोम हैं। Hindi Meaning: उपेक्षा / ध्यान न देना.

t: Which word is the closest synonym for "uplift" as used in the passage?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Uplift" का मतलब है किसी के मूड या स्थिति को 'ऊपर उठाना' या 'बेहतर बनाना' (Improve)। Hindi Meaning: बेहतर बनाना / उत्थान करना.

t: According to the passage, what is one way to support the emotional well-being of older people?
o: Ignoring their concerns to make them independent
Leaving them alone to reflect more
Focusing only on their physical health
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज में साफ़ लिखा है: "emotional wellbeing in old age largely depends on supportive relationships and a sense of purpose. Engaging in hobbies..." (सहयोगपूर्ण रिश्ते और शौक को बढ़ावा देना)।

p: In schools, studying literature often means closely reading a novel, play, or poem without relying much on outside sources. This approach, known as practical criticism, was developed by I.A. Richards (1893-1979) in the 1920s. He believed that focusing on the words themselves and how the writing creates effects would help people judge if a poem was truly 'good' or just had a good reputation. Practical criticism seeks connections among images, themes, and language patterns. Richards and his colleagues saw this method as scientific and thought it led to objective judgments about value. He was part of a group of Cambridge University lecturers who helped shape English Literature as a discipline. Their ideas influenced the New Critics, like John Crowe Ransom (1888-1974) and Cleanth Brooks (1906-94), and their peers in the United States. By examining literature in this way, they created a hierarchy of texts: some were seen as having universal meaning and artistic value, while others were considered too formulaic for serious study. The group of texts seen as most important is often called the literary canon.

t: What did I.A. Richards aim to do through his method of practical criticism?
o: To draw on works from international cultures for a canon diversification.
To allow for autobiographical readings centered on the life of the author.
To first understand the historical and cultural contexts of literature before proceeding with any analysis.
To appraise a text on the basis of language, imagery, and textual patterns.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: आई.ए. रिचर्ड्स की practical criticism में पाठ का मूल्यांकन उसकी भाषा, बिंब और पाठ-पैटर्न के आधार पर किया जाता है।

t: Why did Richards and his colleagues call practical criticism "scientific"?
o: For the reason that it made use of laboratory instruments for the analysis of manuscripts
For the reason that it based its judgment of literary worth on numerical ratings
For the reason that it considered poems as natural phenomena controlled by physical laws
For the reason that it promoted the accurate and repeatable focus on the features of the text
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: इसे 'scientific' कहा गया क्योंकि यह पाठ की विशेषताओं पर सटीक और दोहराने योग्य (objective) ध्यान देती है।

t: How did the New Critics expand upon Richards's theories?
o: They rejected close reading entirely and returned to biographical criticism.
They emphasized regional dialect and folklore studies.
They promoted political readings that foregrounded ideology.
They developed a rigorous form of close reading centered on internal structure.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: न्यू क्रिटिक्स ने रिचर्ड्स के विचारों को आगे बढ़ाकर आंतरिक संरचना पर केंद्रित कठोर close reading विकसित की।

t: What criticism of established reputations does Richards's approach suggest?
o: The idea that unknown authors are more important in history than those who are widely recognized
The argument that only medieval literature deserves serious academic study
The idea that well-known authors should not be part of academic courses
The claim that when a work is very popular, it can hide the fact that it is not actually very good
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: रिचर्ड्स की पद्धति कहती है कि बहुत लोकप्रिय कृति की प्रसिद्धि यह छिपा सकती है कि वह वास्तव में उतनी अच्छी नहीं है।

t: What role did Cambridge University play in shaping English Literature as a discipline, according to the passage?
o: It preserved medieval manuscripts but did not influence modern criticism and popularized modern writing methods
It insisted that students study only contemporary fiction
It discouraged literary study in favor of the sciences
It provided a group of lecturers who formalized methods of close reading and canon formation
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: कैम्ब्रिज के व्याख्याताओं के समूह ने close reading और canon-निर्माण की विधियों को औपचारिक रूप दिया और अंग्रेज़ी साहित्य को विषय के रूप में गढ़ा।

p: In contemporary discourse, the debate between entrepreneurship and conventional employment has gained remarkable traction. While traditional employment offers predictability, structured growth, and a defined career trajectory, entrepreneurship appeals to those seeking autonomy, innovation, and the potential for exponential returns. However, both paths are fraught with distinct advantages and inherent uncertainties. Employment, particularly within established organizations, provides financial stability, social recognition, and institutional support. Employees are not burdened with existential risks such as capital loss or market unpredictability. Instead, they operate within frameworks of responsibility and hierarchy, where risk is absorbed at higher managerial levels. For many, this structure offers psychological comfort and a clear roadmap for progression. Conversely, entrepreneurship demands resilience, resourcefulness, and a high tolerance for ambiguity. Entrepreneurs must navigate volatile markets, regulatory complexities, and the absence of assured income — challenges often underestimated by aspirants. Yet, for those with a risk appetite and creative acumen, entrepreneurship promises a unique form of fulfillment. It allows individuals to disrupt existing paradigms, build ventures from the ground up, and possibly shape industries. Societal perceptions further complicate the dichotomy. In many cultures, steady employment is seen as the hallmark of success, while entrepreneurial endeavors are often perceived as reckless or unstable — until they succeed. This perception, however, is gradually shifting as global startup ecosystems mature and innovation becomes synonymous with progress. The real decision, therefore, lies not in which path is superior but in aligning one's temperament, values, and long-term goals with the demands of each route. Entrepreneurship may offer liberation, but it is not without sacrifice. Employment may provide security, but it can come at the cost of creative constraint. A reflective, context-aware approach — not blind aspiration — is essential for navigating this professional crossroads.

t: According to the passage, which quality is most crucial for entrepreneurs?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज में साफ़ लिखा है: "Conversely, entrepreneurship demands resilience, resourcefulness, and a high tolerance for ambiguity." (उद्यमिता में सबसे पहले 'लचीलेपन या हार न मानने की क्षमता' की ज़रूरत होती है)।

t: Why is employment often psychologically comforting, as per the passage?
o: It eliminates the need for competition
It provides hierarchy and reduced risk
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: नौकरी करने वालों को "psychological comfort" इसलिए मिलता है क्योंकि वे एक 'hierarchy' (पदानुक्रम) में काम करते हैं और सारा रिस्क (risk) ऊपर के मैनेजर उठाते हैं।

t: How does the passage describe societal views toward entrepreneurship?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज कहता है कि समाज शुरुआत में इसे "reckless or unstable" (लापरवाह) मानता है —"until they succeed" (जब तक कि वे सफल न हो जाएँ)। यानी समाज 'संदेह' (Skeptical) करता है।

t: What is implied by "absence of assured income" in the context of entrepreneurship?
o: No fixed salary or stable cash flow
Income is controlled by the government
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Absence of assured income" का सीधा मतलब है कि बिज़नेस में कोई फिक्स सैलरी (fixed salary) या हर महीने आने वाला पक्का पैसा नहीं होता।

t: What does the word "dichotomy" in the passage most nearly mean?
o: A clear division between two contrasting things
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Dichotomy" का अर्थ होता है दो पूरी तरह से अलग या विपरीत चीज़ों के बीच का 'विभाजन या द्वंद्व' (जैसे नौकरी vs बिज़नेस)। Hindi Meaning: द्विभाजन / दो विपरीत चीज़ों का टकराव.

p: Women's fashion in India has undergone remarkable transformation over the decades, mirroring changes in society, culture, and global influences. Traditionally, Indian women wore sarees, ghagras, and salwar suits that varied greatly from region to region, reflecting local craftsmanship and cultural identity. Clothing often indicated a woman's marital status, community, and social standing. In the post-independence era, education, urbanization, and exposure to cinema and international trends reshaped fashion choices. By the 1960s and 70s, urban women started adopting Western attire like skirts and trousers for daily wear, while still preserving traditional fits for festivals and ceremonies. Today, women's fashion in India is an eclectic mix of old and new. Fusion wear combining Western cuts with traditional fabrics has become increasingly popular. Designers are reimagining the saree, giving it modern drapes and pairing it with crop tops or jackets. Fashion is now seen as a means of self-expression, representing confidence, individuality, and cultural pride in an ever-changing world.

t: Identify the correct use of a compound adjective from the passage. Which of the following phrases from the passage is a compound adjective used to modify a noun?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Compound adjective दो या अधिक शब्दों (अक्सर hyphen से जुड़े) से बनता है और एक इकाई की तरह noun को modify करता है। "Post-independence" hyphen वाला है और noun "era" को modify करता है, इसलिए यह compound adjective है। Urban, Traditional और Crop एक-एक शब्द के modifiers हैं। उत्तर (c) Post-independence era।

t: Which sentence from the passage contains a relative clause?
o: Fashion is now seen as a means of self-expression.
Designers are reimagining the saree, giving it modern drapes.
Clothing often indicated a woman's marital status, community, and social standing.
Traditionally, Indian women wore sarees, ghagras, and salwar suits that varied greatly from region to region.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Relative clause एक dependent clause होता है जो who, which या that से शुरू होकर noun को modify करता है। Option (d) में "that varied greatly from region to region" एक defining relative clause है जो "sarees, ghagras, and salwar suits" को modify करता है। (a), (b) और (c) में कोई relative clause नहीं है। उत्तर (d)।

t: The word "eclectic" means:
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Eclectic" ऐसी शैली, पसंद या संग्रह को कहते हैं जो कई तरह के विविध स्रोतों से लिया गया हो, यानी किसी एक परंपरा का पालन न करके मिश्रण बनाता हो। इसलिए (d) Drawing ideas from many sources सबसे सटीक है। "Carefully chosen" क़रीब लगता है पर कई स्रोतों वाला भाव नहीं देता। Hindi Meaning: मिश्रित / विविध स्रोतों से लिया हुआ।

t: What does "craftsmanship" mean in the passage?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Craftsmanship" का अर्थ है हाथ से कुछ बनाने में लगने वाली कुशलता, तकनीक और कला। पैसेज में यह पारंपरिक भारतीय वस्त्र बनाने के लिए ज़रूरी हुनर को बताता है। इसलिए (c) Skill in making things सही है। Hindi Meaning: दस्तकारी / कारीगरी का हुनर।

t: What does the passage suggest about the role of fashion in modern India?
o: It is strictly influenced by Western culture.
It has remained unchanged over the years.
It reflects a blend of tradition, modernity, and personal expression.
It discourages the use of traditional clothing.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज फैशन को "eclectic mix of old and new" बताता है जहाँ डिज़ाइनर पश्चिमी कट को पारंपरिक कपड़ों से मिलाते हैं, और कहता है कि फ़ैशन अब आत्म-अभिव्यक्ति, आत्मविश्वास, व्यक्तित्व और सांस्कृतिक गर्व का माध्यम है। Option (c) परंपरा, आधुनिकता और व्यक्तिगत अभिव्यक्ति तीनों को समेटता है। उत्तर (c)।

p: India and the United Kingdom have shared a strong economic relationship for decades. In recent years, both countries have been working towards finalising a comprehensive trade agreement to boost economic growth and cooperation. This proposed trade deal aims to reduce tariffs, encourage investments, and create new opportunities for businesses in sectors like technology, education, pharmaceuticals, and manufacturing. Negotiations for the agreement have not always been easy. Issues like market access, labour mobility, and regulatory standards have led to lengthy discussions. However, leaders from both sides believe that a fair and balanced trade agreement will benefit millions by generating employment, increasing exports, and strengthening diplomatic ties. Experts say that if successful, the India-UK trade agreement could become a model for future partnerships with other nations. It could help India expand its global reach and attract more foreign investors, while the UK could gain access to India's vast market, which is one of the fastest-growing in the world.

t: In the sentence: "India and the United Kingdom have shared a strong economic relationship for decades," what is the tense of the verb phrase "have shared"?
q.sr: [SSC Stenographer Grade C & D Examination, 2026, 10 sep 2026, Shift-1]
q.e: The verbal combination of the auxiliary "have" plus the past participle "shared" explicitly constitutes the exact present perfect tense. This heavily denotes a continuing relationship that began solidly in the past and extends influentially right up into the current present moment.

t: In the sentence: "Negotiations for the agreement have not always been easy," why is the plural verb "have" used instead of "has"?
o: Because it is in passive voice
Because the sentence is in future tense
q.e: According to incredibly strict rules of subject-verb agreement, the active verb must flawlessly align with the primary subject. Here, the core subject is the plural noun "negotiations", not the prepositional object "agreement", thereby undeniably demanding the plural helping verb "have".

t: The word "tariffs" means:
q.e: In the highly specific realm of international macroeconomics and global business trade deals, "tariffs" unequivocally refers to formal financial taxes or rigid duties imposed exclusively by a sovereign government on incoming imported or outgoing exported manufactured goods.

t: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to "boost" as used in the sentence: "...a comprehensive trade agreement to boost economic growth and cooperation."
q.e: In this intense economic context, to "boost" means to aggressively help or heavily encourage something to rapidly increase, deeply flourish, or massively improve. The precise opposite action would be to actively undermine, suppress, or severely "weaken" that fundamental progress.

t: What is the main purpose of the India-UK trade agreement?
o: To stop all imports and exports
To boost trade, investments, and create opportunities
q.e: The passage explicitly and directly states that the proposed comprehensive trade deal aims "to reduce tariffs, encourage investments, and create new opportunities for businesses", thoroughly boosting overall economic growth and international cooperation.

p: Leadership studies are an emergent discipline, and the concept of leadership will continue to change. Leadership lore is defined as an influence relationship among leaders and followers who want real change and outcomes that reflect their shared purpose.

Leadership involves influence. It occurs among people who intentionally seek significant change, and the changes reflect a shared purpose among leaders and their followers. Influence means that the relationship among people is not passive; however, it is also part of this definition that influence is multidirectional. It does not use orders or threats to make somebody do something. The basic cultural values in America make it easiest to think of leadership as something a leader does to a follower. However, leadership has an effect in both directions. In most organizations, superiors influence subordinates, but subordinates also influence superiors. The people involved in the relationship want real and important changes — leadership involves creating change, not maintaining what normally happens.

t: According to the passage, leadership primarily involves:
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज: नेतृत्व का सार प्रभाव है, यानी सार्थक परिवर्तन की दिशा में दूसरों को प्रभावित करना।

t: Leadership, according to the passage, does not involve:
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: नेतृत्व में प्रभाव निष्क्रिय नहीं होता; पैसेज कहता है कि संबंध passive नहीं हैं, इसलिए 'passive relationships' शामिल नहीं हैं।

t: Based on the passage, which of the following best describes leadership?
o: Leaders tell people what to do and expect them to follow without asking questions.
People compete to be in charge and control what happens at work.
Leaders and followers work together to make changes on purpose.
A passive situation where roles stay the same, and results happen naturally without any intentional effort.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: नेतृत्व में नेता और अनुयायी सोद्देश्य परिवर्तन के लिए मिलकर काम करते हैं; आदेश या धमकी नहीं।

t: When the passage describes influence as "multidirectional," it means that:
o: Influence depends entirely on the personality of the leader rather than the responses of followers.
Influence moves in many directions but ultimately favors the authority of the leader in formal settings.
Influence is unpredictable and tends to weaken organizational stability over time.
Influence is shared among people so that both leaders and followers affect each other's choices and actions.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: 'Multidirectional' का अर्थ है कि प्रभाव दोनों दिशाओं में चलता है: नेता और अनुयायी एक-दूसरे के निर्णयों को प्रभावित करते हैं।

t: The passage explains how leadership is different from routine management for several reasons:
o: Leadership demands intentional, meaningful change rather than merely maintaining what typically happens.
Leadership mainly depends on making people follow rules through orders and tight control.
Leadership does not focus on change but instead reinforces the patterns already in place in the organization.
Leadership is about keeping things stable and making sure current practices continue smoothly.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: नेतृत्व जानबूझकर किया गया सार्थक परिवर्तन है, जबकि सामान्य प्रबंधन यथास्थिति बनाए रखता है।

p: "It is with deep regret that we report a terrible fire which, early on Sunday morning, destroyed a large part of the well-known Borough Market. Although the fire brigades worked hard all through the night, the strong east wind helped the flames spread quickly, burning many stalls and storerooms. Shopkeepers and townspeople watched sadly as the market was ruined. Early investigations suggest that the fire may have started because someone handled a lantern carelessly, but the authorities are still looking into the matter. The Lord Mayor has promised a full review of fire safety rules to prevent such disasters in the future."

t: Which tense is mainly used in the passage?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पूरी घटना हो चुकी है, इसलिए पैसेज में 'destroyed', 'worked', 'helped', 'watched' जैसी वर्ब की Second Form (V2) का इस्तेमाल हुआ है, जो Past Simple tense है।

t: Identify the correct passive voice sentence from the passage.
o: The fire brigades fought the fire bravely.
A large part of the market was destroyed.
The strong wind helped the fire.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Subject (A large part of the market) + was + V3 (destroyed). यह Passive Voice का स्ट्रक्चर है।

t: What does the word "regret" most closely mean?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Regret" का अर्थ है खेद या दुख (sadness)। समाचार रिपोर्टर बहुत दुख (deep regret) के साथ आग लगने की खबर दे रहे हैं। Hindi Meaning: खेद / दुख.

t: What is a "storeroom" in the context of the passage?
o: A room where goods are kept.
A building where meetings are held.
A room where fires are lit.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: 'Storeroom' (गोदाम) वह कमरा होता है जहाँ मार्केट के दुकानदार अपना सामान (goods) रखते हैं। Hindi Meaning: गोदाम / भंडार कक्ष.

t: Why does the Lord Mayor plan to review fire safety rules?
o: To prevent similar disasters in the future
To find out who caused the fire
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज की आखिरी लाइन में स्पष्ट लिखा है: "...review of fire safety rules to prevent such disasters in the future." (ताकि भविष्य में ऐसी आपदाओं को रोका जा सके )।

p: World Handloom Day, observed every year on 7th August, commemorates the launch of the Swadeshi Movement in 1905. It highlights the importance of India's handloom industry, which represents not just craftsmanship but also cultural identity and self-reliance. India is home to over 43 lakh handloom weavers, many of them women in rural communities. Each region contributes a unique weaving style: such as Chanderi, Pochampally Ikat, and Kanjeevaram, reflecting the stories, rituals, and environments of its people. Despite its rich legacy, the handloom sector faces significant challenges. With rising demand for machine-made fabrics, traditional weavers are struggling to sustain their livelihoods. Government efforts, like the India Handloom Brand, aim to revive interest and increase the visibility of hand-woven products. However, access to modern markets and digital platforms remains limited for many artisans. World Handloom Day is more than symbolic. It reminds us that promoting handlooms supports sustainable fashion, local economies, and ecological balance. As consumer awareness grows around eco-friendly choices, handloom garments offer a natural alternative to fast fashion. By supporting handloom products, we are not only preserving a centuries-old tradition but also empowering artisans and encouraging environmentally conscious living.

t: Identify the type of the following sentence from the passage: "Each region contributes a unique weaving style: such as Chanderi, Pochampally Ikat, and Kanjeevaram, reflecting the stories, rituals, and environments of its people."
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: इस वाक्य में केवल एक ही Independent clause है: "Each region contributes a unique weaving style". कॉलन (:) के बाद वाला हिस्सा सिर्फ उदाहरण (appositive) और Participle phrase (reflecting...) है। इसलिए यह एक Simple Sentence है।

t: What is the tense used in the sentence "World Handloom Day, observed every year on 7th August" and why is it appropriate?
o: Past Continuous because the event is ongoing
Present Perfect because it has just happened
Present Simple because it states a general fact
Future Simple because it refers to a yearly event
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Observes/is observed" एक सामान्य तथ्य (General Fact) या हर साल होने वाली घटना (Routine) है। ऐसे तथ्यों के लिए हमेशा Simple Present Tense का प्रयोग होता है।

t: What does "ecological balance" most likely refer to in the sentence "It reminds us that promoting handlooms supports sustainable fashion, local economies, and ecological balance"?
o: Stability and health of the environment
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Ecological balance" (पारिस्थितिक संतुलन) का सीधा अर्थ है 'पर्यावरण की स्थिरता और स्वास्थ्य'। हैंडलूम उद्योग पर्यावरण को नुकसान नहीं पहुँचाता (eco-friendly है)। Hindi Meaning: पर्यावरण का संतुलन.

t: Which idiom best matches the message conveyed by the sentence: "By supporting handloom products, we are not only preserving a centuries-old tradition but also empowering artisans and encouraging environmentally conscious living."
o: Kill two birds with one stone
Let the cat out of the bag
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: इस मुहावरे (Idiom) का मतलब होता है 'एक तीर से दो (या कई) निशाने लगाना'। हैंडलूम खरीदकर हम एक साथ कई काम कर रहे हैं—परंपरा बचाना, कारीगरों को सशक्त करना और पर्यावरण को बचाना।

t: What is the main purpose of observing World Handloom Day, according to the passage?

p: Democracy is frequently extolled as the political system that best guarantees individual liberty. Enshrined in constitutional rights and protected by the rule of law, freedom of speech, association, religion, and conscience are regarded as hallmarks of democratic governance. However, what is less frequently acknowledged but equally vital — is the reciprocal pillar of responsibility without which such freedoms can degenerate into chaos, polarization, or authoritarian backlashes. Freedom in a democracy is not absolute; it exists within a framework of mutual restraint and civic discipline. The right to express dissent, for instance, is foundational. Yet when freedom of expression is weaponized to disseminate hate speech, misinformation, or seditious propaganda, it ceases to serve the democratic cause. Responsibility thus entails a conscious engagement with the implications of one's actions — not just their legality, but their ethical and civic consequences. The challenge lies in reconciling liberty with accountability in pluralistic societies. With diverse cultural, ideological, and economic constituencies, democracies are inherently sites of contention. In such contexts, responsibility demands more than legal compliance — it requires empathy, critical thinking, and a commitment to collective well-being. A citizen's right to protest, for example, must be exercised with awareness of public order and respect for differing viewpoints. Similarly, the freedom to vote must be matched by an obligation to make informed choices, unswayed by populism, prejudice, or manipulation. The tension between freedom and responsibility is perhaps most visible during moments of crisis — be it a pandemic, a communal riot, or a constitutional standoff. In such times, the temptation to prioritize personal liberty at the cost of collective safety can prove fatal. Refusal to wear masks during a health emergency or the viral spread of unverified news during civil unrest exemplify how unbridled freedom can undermine democratic resilience. Moreover, democracy itself is not self-sustaining; it requires vigilant citizens who recognize that rights are not entitlements in perpetuity, but privileges preserved through active participation. When freedom is divorced from responsibility, democratic institutions become vulnerable to erosion — from within. Demagogues often rise not solely because of state failure, but due to civic apathy or irresponsible use of democratic freedoms by the populace itself. Therefore, in any functioning democracy, freedom and responsibility are not opposing forces but mutually reinforcing imperatives. The preservation of liberty necessitates a citizenry capable of ethical judgment, informed debate, and constructive dissent. In the absence of responsibility, freedom risks transforming from a catalyst of justice into a vehicle of division. Democracy survives not just through the laws it enacts, but through the civic virtues its citizens embody.

t: According to the passage, what happens when freedom is exercised without responsibility?
o: It leads to misuse and societal harm
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज कहता है: "freedoms can degenerate into chaos, polarization, or authoritarian backlashes." (बिना ज़िम्मेदारी के आज़ादी समाज में अराजकता और नुकसान फैलाती है)।

t: Why does the author mention protests and voting as examples?
o: To show areas where freedom and responsibility must coexist
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: लेखक ने प्रदर्शन (protest) और वोटिंग के अधिकार का उदाहरण देकर समझाया है कि कैसे आज़ादी (freedom) के साथ-साथ सार्वजनिक व्यवस्था और सही चुनाव की ज़िम्मेदारी (responsibility) भी जुड़ी होनी चाहिए।

t: What is implied about the relationship between citizens and democratic institutions?
o: Citizens play an active role in sustaining democracy
Democratic institutions should restrict citizens' rights
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज में साफ़ लिखा है: "democracy itself is not self-sustaining; it requires vigilant citizens..." (नागरिकों की सक्रिय भागीदारी ही लोकतंत्र को बचाए रखती है)।

t: How does the passage describe the impact of crises on freedom in democracies?
o: Crises show the need for absolute state control
Crises reveal the dangers of unregulated freedom
Crises diminish the value of rights
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: महामारी या दंगों के समय में यह साफ दिखता है कि: "prioritize personal liberty at the cost of collective safety can prove fatal." (संकट के समय बेलगाम आज़ादी समाज के लिए खतरा बन जाती है)।

t: What tone best describes the author's stance on freedom in democracy?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: लेखक ने लोकतंत्र में आज़ादी की महत्ता को स्वीकारा है (Balanced) लेकिन साथ ही ज़िम्मेदारी न निभाने के गंभीर परिणामों की 'चेतावनी' (Cautionary) भी दी है।

p: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is gradually transforming the way students learn. From virtual tutors to personalized learning paths, AI helps identify each learner's strengths and weaknesses. With the help of data, AI systems can suggest specific topics where students need improvement. Schools are also using AI chatbots to answer basic queries, reducing the pressure on teachers. However, experts warn that over-dependence on AI may limit critical thinking. If students rely too much on machines for answers, they may lose problem-solving skills. There are also concerns about data privacy, especially when student performance data is stored online. Despite these issues, many educators believe AI can be a useful tool when used wisely. Like any technology, the key lies in balancing human guidance with machine efficiency.

t: What does AI mainly help with in education?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज की शुरुआत में ही है: "From virtual tutors to personalized learning paths..." (AI हर छात्र की कमज़ोरी और ताकत के हिसाब से पढ़ाई को कस्टमाइज़ करता है )।

t: What is a possible risk of overusing AI?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: चेतावनी दी गई है कि "over-dependence on AI may limit critical thinking" (ज़्यादा निर्भरता से बच्चों की सोचने-समझने और प्रॉब्लम सॉल्व करने की क्षमता कमज़ोर हो सकती है)।

t: Why are AI chatbots used in schools?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Schools are also using AI chatbots to answer basic queries..." (छात्रों के बेसिक सवालों के जवाब देने के लिए)।

t: What is a concern related to student data?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज में स्पष्ट रूप से "concerns about data privacy" (ऑनलाइन डेटा स्टोर होने पर प्राइवेसी का खतरा) का ज़िक्र है।

t: What is the author's final advice?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज की बिल्कुल आखिरी लाइन निष्कर्ष निकालती है: "the key lies in balancing human guidance with machine efficiency" (यानी मशीन और इंसान दोनों के बीच संतुलन ज़रूरी है)।

p: Climate change has come to define the twenty-first century, and not merely as an environmental issue. It is equally a social and ethical challenge. Scientific evidence makes it clear that human activity lies at the heart of rising global temperatures. Yet the effects of this crisis are far from evenly shared. Communities that have contributed least to greenhouse gas emissions often suffer the most—through displacement, food insecurity, and the erosion of livelihoods. This uneven burden brings questions of climate justice and global responsibility to the forefront. Progress, however, remains slow. Political hesitation and strong economic interests still slow down real action, which leads to public frustration and less trust in the institutions meant to handle the crisis. Because of this, we cannot rely only on technology to solve climate change. We need a shared moral commitment, policies that include everyone and are fair, and a major change in development priorities so that long-term sustainability comes before short-term profits.

t: Why is climate change considered more than an environmental issue?
o: It only affects ecosystems and does not impact human societies.
It is just about scientific debates and technology.
It is only about economic growth and industrial development.
It is also a social and ethical issue that affects justice and responsibility.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: जलवायु परिवर्तन केवल पर्यावरणीय नहीं, सामाजिक और नैतिक चुनौती भी है, जो न्याय और वैश्विक ज़िम्मेदारी के सवाल उठाता है।

t: Which communities suffer most from climate change impacts?
o: Industrialized countries with high carbon footprints
Those that contributed least to greenhouse gas emissions
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: जिन समुदायों ने ग्रीनहाउस उत्सर्जन में सबसे कम योगदान दिया, वही विस्थापन, खाद्य असुरक्षा और आजीविका-क्षरण से सबसे ज़्यादा पीड़ित होते हैं।

t: Name one of the major obstacles to advancing efforts to counter climate change.
o: A global unity and support for sustainability for all nations
Widespread adoption of renewable energy resources
Open government and climate policies that include everyone
Political hesitation and powerful economic interests that favor short-term gains
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज: राजनीतिक हिचकिचाहट और मजबूत आर्थिक हित वास्तविक कार्रवाई को धीमा करते हैं।

t: According to the passage, what main change in development priorities is being suggested?
o: Making economic growth the top priority, even if it harms the environment
Increasing industrial growth to keep up with consumer demand

Focusing on long-term sustainability instead of short-term profits

p: Despite significant progress in mental health awareness, visiting a psychiatrist remains a taboo for many people in India. Deep-rooted cultural beliefs, lack of education about mental illnesses, and the fear of social judgment often prevent individuals from seeking professional help when they need it most. Instead, many people choose to suffer in silence or rely solely on family advice, which may not always be sufficient. However, mental health experts emphasize that consulting a qualified psychiatrist is not a sign of weakness but a step towards healing and self-care. Just as one would visit a doctor for physical ailments, mental health conditions deserve equal attention and professional treatment. Unfortunately, the stigma attached to mental health persists, discouraging open conversations and timely intervention. Breaking this taboo requires collective effort — families, schools, workplaces, and communities must foster an environment where seeking mental health support is normalised and encouraged. Only then can India hope to reduce the burden of untreated mental illnesses and improve overall societal well-being.

t: Identify the tense used in the sentence: "Just as one would visit a doctor for physical ailments; mental health conditions deserve equal attention."
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: मुख्य क्लॉज़ है "mental health conditions deserve equal attention." यहाँ "deserve" (V1) का प्रयोग हुआ है जो एक सामान्य तथ्य (General Truth) को बता रहा है। यह Simple Present Tense का उदाहरण है। इसमें कोई Auxiliary Verb (has/have) नहीं है।

t: Identify the voice used in the sentence: "Instead, many people choose to suffer in silence."
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Subject "many people" खुद क्रिया 'choose' (चुनते हैं) को कर रहा है। यहाँ कर्ता (doer) सक्रिय है। जब Subject स्वयंकाम करता है, तो वह Active Voice होता है।

t: What does the word "taboo" most likely mean in the passage?
o: A forbidden or socially unacceptable practice
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Taboo" (वर्जित) का अर्थ होता है एक ऐसी सामाजिक प्रथा जिसे समाज द्वारा अस्वीकार्य या गलत माना जाता है (जैसे मानसिक स्वास्थ्य के लिए डॉक्टर के पास जाना)। Hindi Meaning: सामाजिक रूप से वर्जित या निषिद्ध बात.

t: What does the phrase "suffer in silence" mean in the context of the passage?
o: To speak openly about one's problems
To get treatment without anyone knowing
To discuss mental health with family only
To hide one's pain and not seek help
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Suffer in silence" (खामोशी से सहना) एक मुहावरा है जिसका अर्थ होता है अपनी परेशानी को छिपाना और किसी से मदद न मांगना। लोग समाज के डर से अपनी मानसिक तकलीफों को छिपाते हैं। Hindi Meaning: दर्द को छिपाना और मदद न माँगना.

t: Why do many people in India avoid visiting a psychiatrist?
o: Cultural beliefs and fear of social judgment
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज की दूसरी लाइन में साफ़ लिखा है: "Deep-rooted cultural beliefs, lack of education about mental illnesses, and the fear of social judgment often prevent individuals from seeking professional help..." (सांस्कृतिक मान्यताएं और सामाजिक निर्णय का डर लोगों को रोकते हैं)।

p: While financial inclusion is often praised as a driver of equitable growth, its implementation in rural India presents a paradox. On paper, schemes such as the Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY), Aadhaar-enabled payment systems, and mobile banking have revolutionized access. Yet, in practice, access does not necessarily translate into utility. A significant number of rural account holders remain dormant users, often constrained by digital illiteracy, infrastructural limitations, and deeply entrenched socio-cultural barriers. In numerous villages, banking correspondents (BCs) — the foot soldiers of India's rural financial architecture — are overburdened, undertrained, and often unsupported by robust technological infrastructure. The notion that a biometric fingerprint or a one-time password could substitute for financial literacy is naïve at best. Many beneficiaries, especially women, face systemic exclusion, not just due to lack of documentation, but because patriarchal norms often discourage or control women's interactions with banking services. Moreover, while financial inclusion aims to integrate the rural poor into the formal economy, the informal credit system continues to flourish. This coexistence is not accidental but symptomatic of a trust deficit and functional inefficiencies within formal institutions. Local moneylenders, albeit exploitative, offer immediacy and familiarity, elements often absent in bureaucratic banking processes. The digital push, accelerated post-2016 demonetization and COVID-19, has undoubtedly expanded the ecosystem. However, digital penetration without digital comprehension can widen the exclusion gap. Without focused digital education, grievance redressal mechanisms, and gender-sensitive outreach, financial inclusion may remain more rhetorical than real. In essence, true inclusion cannot be measured merely by the number of accounts opened but must reflect active participation, trust, and accessibility across gender, literacy, and regional lines. Until then, the dream of a financially empowered rural India will remain aspirational.

t: According to the passage, what is the main paradox of financial inclusion in rural India?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "access does not necessarily translate into utility. A significant number of rural account holders remain dormant users..." (अकाउंट तो खुल गए हैं , लेकिन लोग उनका इस्तेमाल नहीं कर रहे हैं, यही सबसे बड़ा विरोधाभास है)।

t: Why do informal credit systems persist despite formal financial inclusion efforts?
o: Trust and familiarity of local lenders
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Local moneylenders, albeit exploitative, offer immediacy and familiarity..." (स्थानीय साहूकारों पर लोगों का भरोसा और जान-पहचान होती है जो बैंकों में नहीं होती)।

t: Which factor does not contribute to dormant rural bank accounts, as per the passage?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज में 'digital illiteracy', 'patriarchal norms' और 'lack of financial literacy' को खातों के बंद (dormant) होने का कारण बताया गया है। 'Mobile network expansion' (नेटवर्क का बढ़ना) तो एक सकारात्मक कदम है।

t: What assumption does the author criticize regarding digital financial systems?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: लेखक इस बात को नासमझी (naive) मानता है कि एक बायोमेट्रिक फिंगरप्रिंट या "one-time password (OTP) could substitute for financial literacy."

t: What is implied about women's financial inclusion in rural India?
o: They benefit more from informal lenders
Lack of Aadhaar is the main barrier
Cultural factors hinder their financial agency
They lead financial decisions at home
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: महिलाओं के मामले में, "patriarchal norms" (पितृसत्तात्मक यानी सांस्कृतिक नियम) उन्हें बैंकिंग सेवाओं का उपयोग करने से रोकते हैं।

t: According to the passage, what is the main paradox of financial inclusion in rural India?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: विरोधाभास (paradox) यह है कि कागज़ों पर लोगों के पास बैंक अकाउंट का "Access" तो है, लेकिन वास्तव में वे उसका 'इस्तेमाल' (Utility/usage) नहीं कर रहे हैं (dormant users)।

p: Once relegated to the peripheries of legitimate professional discourse, YouTube content creation has metamorphosed into a formidable and highly nuanced career avenue. Far beyond the superficial glitz of viral videos, contemporary content creators must navigate a labyrinthine ecosystem encompassing algorithmic unpredictability, audience analytics, intellectual property considerations, and brand partnership intricacies.

The platform's democratized nature ostensibly offers an egalitarian promise — anyone with a camera and an idea can, theoretically, ascend to prominence. However, the reality is far more Darwinian. Success on YouTube today demands not only creative ingenuity but also a keen acumen in digital marketing, search engine optimization (SEO), and an ever-evolving understanding of platform-specific trends.
