Consistency in output, meticulous engagement with viewer communities, and adaptability to sudden policy shifts have become indispensable skills.

Moreover, the psychological ramifications of tethering one's livelihood to fluctuating view counts and algorithmic favor should not be underestimated. Burnout, imposter syndrome, and a precarious sense of self-worth plague many full-time creators. Unlike traditional careers, YouTube offers no institutional safety nets; creators must independently negotiate contracts, secure health benefits, and plan for financial volatility.

Nonetheless, for those who can master this digital alchemy, the rewards are substantial — both financially and creatively. The platform enables unparalleled autonomy, offering a direct conduit between creator and audience, unmediated by corporate gatekeepers. In an era increasingly defined by the decentralization of media, YouTube content creation is not merely a trend but a harbinger of the future of work.

Identify the grammatical function of the phrase "offering a direct conduit between creator and audience" in the sentence: "The platform enables unparalleled autonomy, offering a direct conduit between creator and audience, unmediated by corporate gatekeepers."

t: In the sentence "Far beyond the superficial glitz of viral videos, contemporary content creators must navigate a labyrinthine ecosystem encompassing algorithmic unpredictability..."
What is the function of the introductory phrase "Far beyond the superficial glitz of viral videos"?
o: Prepositional phrase functioning as a noun
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: यह एक Prepositional phrase है जो वाक्य की शुरुआत में आकर मुख्य क्रिया "navigate" के संदर्भ (context/scope) को स्पष्ट कर रहा है कि उन्हें कहाँ और किस हद तक नेविगेट करना है।

t: What is the closest meaning of the word "labyrinthine" as used in the passage?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Labyrinthine" शब्द 'Labyrinth' (भूलभुलैया) से बना है। इसका अर्थ होता है कोई ऐसा सिस्टम जो बहुत ही रहस्यमय, जटिल और जिसमें उलझन हो (confusingly complex)। Hindi Meaning: भूलभुलैया जैसा / बेहद जटिल.

t: Choose the most appropriate antonym for the word "harbinger" as used in the last line of the passage.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Harbinger" का अर्थ होता है अग्रदूत या किसी आने वाली चीज़ का 'संकेत देने वाला' (Precursor / forerunner)। इसका विलोम (Antonym) वह होगा जो पीछे चलता हो, यानी "Follower" (अनुयायी)।

t: Which of the following best captures the primary tension described in the passage?
o: The tension between traditional media and decentralized platforms
The tension between the glamorized perception of content creation and its actual challenges
The tension between corporate sponsorships and independent artistry
The tension between financial rewards and creative compromises
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पूरे पैसेज में यूट्यूब के बाहरी ग्लैमर (egalitarian promise, superficial glitz) और इसके पीछे की कड़वी सच्चाई (Darwinian reality, burnout, financial volatility) के बीच के तनाव को दर्शाया गया है।

p: Plastic surgery has become increasingly common in recent years, with millions of people opting for cosmetic procedures to enhance their physical appearance. While advancements in medical technology have made surgeries safer and more accessible, there are still significant risks associated with altering one's body artificially. One of the major negative effects of plastic surgery is the risk of medical complications such as infections, scarring, and even organ damage in severe cases. Additionally, repeated surgeries can weaken the body's natural healing process. Apart from physical risks, plastic surgery can also have psychological consequences. Many people develop unrealistic expectations, which often leads to dissatisfaction, anxiety, and low self-esteem when results do not match their ideal image. Moreover, an excessive focus on outward beauty can promote superficial values in society, encouraging people to judge themselves and others based solely on appearance. In the long run, this obsession may damage mental health and erode genuine self-confidence. Therefore, it is important to weigh the risks and benefits before choosing to undergo cosmetic surgery.

t: Which of the following conjunctions is NOT used in the passage?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज में "While", "Apart from" और "And" conjunctions/linking words प्रयोग हुए हैं, पर "Because" पूरे पाठ में कहीं नहीं आया है। इसलिए विकल्पों में यही वह conjunction है जो पैसेज में प्रयोग नहीं हुआ। प्रश्न "NOT used" पूछता है, इसलिए उत्तर (c) Because।

t: Identify the sentence from the passage that contains a relative pronoun, and choose the correct type of pronoun used.
o: Plastic surgery has become increasingly common in recent years.
While advancements in medical technology have made surgeries safer and more accessible...
Many people develop unrealistic expectations, which often leads to dissatisfaction...
An excessive focus on outward beauty can promote superficial values in society.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Relative pronoun वह होता है जो किसी noun को modify करने वाला clause शुरू करता है। Option (c) में "which" एक relative pronoun है जो "unrealistic expectations" को "which often leads to dissatisfaction" वाले clause से जोड़ता है। (a), (b) और (d) में कोई relative pronoun नहीं है। उत्तर (c)।

t: What does "superficial" mean in this passage?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: इस संदर्भ में "superficial" उन मूल्यों को बताता है जो सिर्फ़ दिखने वाली शारीरिक सुंदरता की परवाह करते हैं, यानी उथले और गहराई से रहित। इसलिए (b) Focusing only on surface appearance सही है और "Deep and thoughtful" इसका antonym है। Hindi Meaning: सतही / दिखावटी।

t: The word "obsession" means:
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Obsession" उस विचार या धुन को कहते हैं जो इंसान के दिमाग़ पर बेक़ाबू ढंग से इतना हावी हो जाए कि परेशान करने लगे। पैसेज में यह बाहरी सुंदरता के प्रति ऐसी अस्वस्थ सनक है जो मानसिक सेहत बिगाड़ती है। उत्तर (c) An intense and unhealthy focus। Hindi Meaning: सनक / जुनून।

t: What are two major risks associated with plastic surgery, according to the passage?
o: Increased social approval and career growth
Enhanced physical fitness and reduced anxiety
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज दो तरह के जोखिमों को अलग-अलग paragraphs में बताता है: शारीरिक "medical complications" (संक्रमण, निशान, अंगों को नुकसान) और "psychological consequences" (चिंता, असंतोष, कम आत्मसम्मान)। Option (c) दोनों श्रेणियों को दर्शाता है। उत्तर (c)।

p: In the modern medical world, robotic surgeries are becoming increasingly common. With the help of advanced technology, surgeons can now perform complex procedures with greater precision and control. Robotic surgical systems allow doctors to make smaller incisions, which often means less pain, minimal blood loss, and faster recovery for patients. Hospitals across the globe are investing in robotic surgery equipment to provide better healthcare services. Although robotic surgeries can be more expensive than traditional methods, many believe the benefits justify the cost. Surgeons also need special training to handle these sophisticated machines effectively. However, there are concerns too. Some critics argue that over-reliance on robotic systems might reduce surgeons' manual skills over time. Others worry that the high costs may limit access for poorer patients. Despite these challenges, experts agree that robotic surgeries will continue to grow and transform the medical field in the coming years.

t: The word "precision" means:
q.sr: [SSC Stenographer Grade C & D 2026, 10 Sep 2026, Shift-3]
q.e: The word "precision" refers to the quality, condition, or fact of being exact and accurate. In surgical contexts, it relates to the surgeon's ability to operate with meticulous accuracy, making "Accuracy and exactness" the correct definition.

t: The word "sophisticated" means:
q.e: In the context of machinery and technology, "sophisticated" describes equipment that is developed to a high degree of complexity and advancement. Therefore, "Advanced and complex" is the accurate meaning.

t: In the sentence: "Robotic surgeries are becoming increasingly common," what is the tense of the verb phrase "are becoming"?
q.e: The verb phrase "are becoming" consists of the present tense auxiliary "are" and the present participle "-ing" verb "becoming." This specific structure formally denotes the present continuous (or present progressive) tense.

t: In the sentence: "Hospitals across the globe are investing in robotic surgery equipment to provide better healthcare services," what is the voice of the verb "are investing"?
q.e: The sentence is in the active voice because the subject ("Hospitals across the globe") is the entity actively performing the action of the verb ("are investing"). A passive construction would frame the equipment as being invested in by the hospitals.

p: The true role of our energy is to gain personal power and operate from it at all times. Today, in many situations, people lose their personal power in relationships such as boss-subordinate, client-customer, colleague-colleague, teacher-student, husband-wife, parent-child, friend-friend, etc. Often in these relationships, someone plays the role of the oppressor while the other plays the role of the oppressed. But this is a significant weakness in the relationship, undermining people's capacity to be their authentic selves and accomplish what they want in their lives. We need personal power to hold our self-esteem and go forward to succeed in our pursuits. Human relationships often deteriorate through these power struggles, and ultimately, both, whether they are playing the role of an oppressor or the oppressed, lose their personal power. Personal power can be seen as the result of an interplay between masculine and feminine forms of power: both can coexist in men and women. Both feminine and the masculine forms of power need to be honored and expressed for a beautiful presence and creation in the world. We need a deeper understanding of the characteristics of masculine and feminine forms of power.

t: Relationships of different types of power among people will lead to:
o: Subjugation of the weak and meek
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज: संबंधों में शक्ति-संघर्ष से एक उत्पीड़क और दूसरा उत्पीड़ित बनता है, यानी कमज़ोर और विनम्र का दमन होता है।

t: The interplay of both feminine and masculine power is essential for:
o: A distinguishing factor in gender-based dynamics
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज: विश्व में सुंदर उपस्थिति और रचना के लिए स्त्रैण और पुरुषोचित दोनों शक्ति-रूपों का सम्मान और अभिव्यक्ति आवश्यक है।

t: The passage addresses the concept of:
o: The significance of power struggles among different countries
Various forms and structures of power
The necessity of dividing power within society
Harnessing personal power in the interest of co-existence
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज का विषय: सह-अस्तित्व के हित में व्यक्तिगत शक्ति (personal power) को पाना और उसका उपयोग करना।

t: The loss of personal power within society can be attributed to several factors:
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज: मानवीय संबंध शक्ति-संघर्षों से बिगड़ते हैं और अंततः दोनों पक्ष अपनी व्यक्तिगत शक्ति खो देते हैं।

t: Power relations within a society typically result in the following outcomes:
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज: ये संबंध लोगों की आत्म-अभिव्यक्ति और अपने लक्ष्य प्राप्त करने की क्षमता को कमज़ोर करते हैं, यानी आत्म-सिद्धि के अवसर घटते हैं।

p: The relationship between morality and legality is neither linear nor synonymous. Though often conflated in everyday discourse, they belong to distinct conceptual realms. Legality refers to conformity with codified rules enforced by the state, whereas morality is guided by principles of right and wrong, which are often subjective and culturally contingent. The divergence between what is legal and what is moral forms one of the most enduring dilemmas in jurisprudence and civil ethics. Laws, by their very nature, are prescriptive and institutionalized, grounded in the need for order, predictability, and enforceability. Yet, legal codes are ultimately constructed within specific historical, political, and social contexts, and thus may reflect prevailing power structures more than universal justice. For instance, colonial laws legalizing racial segregation or past statutes criminalizing homosexuality demonstrate how legality can institutionalize what many later recognize as moral failures. Conversely, acts of civil disobedience — illegal by definition — often draw moral legitimacy from a higher ethical calling. Mahatma Gandhi's Salt March or Rosa Parks' defiance on a segregated bus were technically unlawful, yet they served as moral catalysts for transformative legal reform. This underscores a vital point: legality does not always equate to justice, and at times, morality must challenge the law to realign it with evolving human values. However, conflating morality with legality can be equally dangerous. In pluralistic societies, what constitutes "moral" varies widely across cultures, religions, and ideologies. If law were to enforce a singular moral worldview, it would risk descending into authoritarianism or theocracy. Hence, modern democratic legal systems are designed to be procedurally neutral, relying on constitutional frameworks that protect individual rights while accommodating moral diversity. The tension between morality and legality is also palpable in emerging debates around technology, bioethics, and freedom of expression. Laws often lag behind technological advances, creating grey zones where ethical concerns arise before legal clarity is established. Consider data privacy or artificial intelligence — practices that may be legal today but pose moral quandaries about consent, autonomy, and manipulation. Ultimately, an ideal legal system should neither operate in moral vacuum nor serve as a mere extension of moral absolutism. Instead, it must strike a delicate balance — upholding constitutional values while remaining responsive to the ethical pulse of the time. Citizens, too, bear a responsibility: to not only obey the law but to question it when it stagnates or strays from principles of justice.

t: What central idea does the passage emphasize about legality?
o: It is always aligned with morality
It should be based solely on religious values
It is contextually shaped and not always just
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज कहता है कि कानून (legality) अक्सर समय, समाज और ताकतवर लोगों के हिसाब से बनते हैं ("constructed within specific historical... contexts")। इसलिए जो कानूनी है, वह हमेशा 'न्यायपूर्ण' (just) नहीं होता (जैसे अंग्रेज़ों के कानून)।

t: Why does the author mention acts like Gandhi's Salt March and Rosa Parks' defiance?
o: To show how legal systems support all moral actions
To illustrate when legal disobedience is morally valid
To argue for stricter law enforcement
To show that all moral actions are illegal
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: गांधीजी का दांडी मार्च या रोज़ा पार्क्स का विरोध कानूनी रूप से तो 'अवैध' (illegal) था, लेकिन 'नैतिक' (moral) रूप से बिल्कुल सही था। ये उदाहरण बताते हैं कि कब कानून तोड़ना नैतिक रूप से जायज़ हो सकता है।

t: According to the passage, what risk arises from equating morality with legality in pluralistic societies?
o: It may lead to authoritarian imposition of a singular worldview
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: विविध समाज (pluralistic societies) में हर धर्म/संस्कृति की नैतिकता अलग होती है। अगर कानून किसी एक की नैतिकता को सब पर थोपने (conflating morality with legality) लगे, तो वह देश एक तानाशाही (authoritarianism) बन जाएगा।

t: What challenge does the passage highlight in the legal treatment of emerging technologies?
o: All ethical dilemmas are solved by law
Ethics arise before legal frameworks are formed
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: नई तकनीक (जैसे AI) के मामले में: "Laws often lag behind technological advances..." (तकनीक आगे निकल जाती है और उसके नैतिक सवाल पहले आ जाते हैं, जबकि कानून बहुत बाद में बनते हैं)।

t: What is the author's ultimate recommendation regarding the interplay of law and morality?
o: Citizens must obey all laws blindly
Law and morality should be entirely separate
Law must balance justice with moral responsiveness
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: अंत में निष्कर्ष है कि "it must strike a delicate balance..." (कानून को संवैधानिक मूल्यों और बदलते समय की नैतिकता के बीच संतुलन बनाना चाहिए)।

p: Over the past few years, there has been a noticeable surge in gold prices across global and Indian markets. Several factors contribute to this rise, including inflation, geopolitical tensions, fluctuating currency values, and increased consumer demand. However, many financial experts argue that the current hype surrounding gold rates is not entirely based on practical factors but is partly driven by emotional buying and media influence. In India, gold holds cultural and emotional value, especially during weddings and festivals. This emotional attachment often leads to panic buying whenever there's even a minor increase in prices, further pushing the rates upward. Moreover, with social media platforms constantly updating people about price movements, the perception of scarcity or urgency tends to fuel impulsive investments. While gold is traditionally considered a "safe haven" asset during uncertain times, experts advise caution. Blindly following the hype can result in financial decisions that may not align with long-term goals. A balanced approach, guided by market research and expert opinion, is more beneficial than reacting to temporary trends.

t: Which is the correct verb tense used in the sentence: "There has been a noticeable surge in gold prices..."?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Has been" संरचना Has + V3 को दर्शाती है, जो कि Present Perfect Tense है। यह बताता है कि कोई चीज़ पास्ट में शुरू हुई और वर्तमान में भी जारी है (सोने के दामों में उछाल)।

t: Identify the passive voice sentence from the passage:
o: The perception of scarcity fuels investments.
Several factors contribute to the rise.
The current hype surrounding gold rates is not entirely based on practical factors.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: इस वाक्य में "is... based on" (To be verb + V3) का स्ट्रक्चर है, जो स्पष्ट रूप से Passive Voice की निशानी है। बाकी सभी विकल्प Active Voice में हैं।

t: What does the word "impulsive" most likely mean in the context of the passage?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Impulsive" (आवेगपूर्ण) का अर्थ है बिना सोचे-समझे, अचानक और भावनाओं में बहकर (sudden and emotional) कोई कदम उठाना (जैसे सोने में निवेश कर देना)। Hindi Meaning: आवेगपूर्ण / बिना सोचे समझे किया गया काम.

t: What is the meaning of "safe haven" as used in the passage?
o: A secure place to park money during uncertainty
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Safe haven" (सुरक्षित आश्रय) अर्थशास्त्र में उस संपत्ति (Asset) को कहते हैं जिसका मूल्य अनिश्चितता (uncertain times) या मंदी के समय में भी गिरता नहीं है। Hindi Meaning: सुरक्षित निवेश का साधन.

t: According to the passage, what is one reason behind the surge in gold prices in India besides economic factors?
o: Strict government policies on gold trade
Emotional buying influenced by cultural traditions
Lack of interest in other investment options
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज में साफ़ लिखा है: "In India, gold holds cultural and emotional value... This emotional attachment often leads to panic buying." (भारत में सांस्कृतिक परंपराओं के कारण भावनात्मक खरीदारी होती है)।

p: People will invest in education if they are given the economic freedom to fully enjoy the benefits. As has become the norm, people invest in education because the marginal return on education increases their economic freedom. It is a sound decision to invest in education if, after tax rate reductions, people can enjoy a certain income marginally higher than the income they derive from improving educational levels. However, it makes no significant sense to invest in education if the government taxes the income of educated people at a very high rate. The same applies to parents who wish to improve their children's educational standards.

t: According to the passage, people invest in education because:
o: It increases their marginal returns and expands their economic freedom.
It guarantees government employment regardless of skill.
It protects them completely from future taxation.
It ensures equal income across all education levels.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज: लोग शिक्षा में निवेश इसलिए करते हैं क्योंकि उसका सीमांत प्रतिफल (marginal return) उनकी आर्थिक स्वतंत्रता बढ़ाता है।

t: When does it make economic sense for individuals to invest in education?
o: When tax rates increase sharply for all educated individuals.
When reduced tax rates allow them to enjoy income gains from higher education.
When education makes no difference in income level.
When the government eliminates all forms of rewards for studying.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: कर-दरों में कटौती के बाद जब शिक्षा से आय थोड़ी भी अधिक मिले, तभी शिक्षा में निवेश समझदारी है।

t: Why does the passage claim that high taxation reduces educational investment?
o: Because high taxes eliminate all job opportunities.
Because taxes discourage schools from admitting new students.
Because heavy tax rates diminish the economic rewards of being educated.
Because taxes reduce the cost of gaining educational qualifications.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: ऊँचे कर शिक्षित व्यक्ति की आय के लाभ को घटा देते हैं, इसलिए शिक्षा में निवेश की प्रेरणा कम होती है।

t: What message the passage conveys about parents spending on the educational advancement of children?
o: Parents invest solely for cultural reasons.
Parents are motivated only when schooling secures elite-group membership.
Taxes do not affect parents in making decisions about education.
Their intentions are consistent with investment incentives on an individual level.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज: 'The same applies to parents', यानी माता-पिता भी व्यक्तिगत स्तर पर निवेश-प्रोत्साहनों के अनुरूप ही निर्णय लेते हैं।

t: Which economic principle best explains the behavior described in the passage?
o: In rational decision-making, the cost of education is not high.
People will always select occupations with lower income, irrespective of returns.
People react to incentives and invest whenever the marginal benefit exceeds the marginal cost.
Educational choices are made only on an emotional basis.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज प्रोत्साहनों पर प्रतिक्रिया का सिद्धांत दर्शाता है: जब सीमांत लाभ सीमांत लागत से अधिक हो, लोग निवेश करते हैं।

p: Much of the discussion in this book is about biases of intuition. However, the focus on biases does not mean that intuition is always wrong-far from it. Most of the time, the quick judgments of our intuitive mind, what I call System 1, are accurate enough to help us navigate the world. This system operates automatically and quickly, with little or no effort. On the other hand, System 2 is the slower, more deliberate mode of thinking. It allocates attention to effortful mental activities, such as solving complex problems or evaluating logical arguments. System 2 is more methodical and rational, but it is also lazier-it prefers to endorse the intuitions of System 1 rather than question them. This division of labour works well most of the time, but it also creates predictable errors. Because System 1 is prone to biases and snap judgments, we often make decisions that are not as rational as we believe.
Understanding these two systems can help us recognize when we are relying too much on intuition and when we need to engage in more deliberate thinking.

t: Identify the sentence with correct subject-verb agreement:
o: The quick judgments of our intuitive mind, what I call System 1, is accurate enough to help us navigate the world.
This division of labor work well most of the time, but it also creates predictable errors.
Understanding these two systems can helps us recognize when we are relying too much on intuition.
System 2 allocates attention to effortful mental activities, such as solving complex problems or evaluating logical arguments.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: 'System 2' एक Singular Subject है, इसलिए इसके साथ Singular Verb 'allocates' (V1+s) का योग बिल्कुल सही है। (बाकी विकल्पों में Singular/Plural और Modal Verb के प्रयोग की गलतियां हैं)।

t: Choose the sentence that correctly uses a relative pronoun:
o: System 1 is the intuitive mode of thinking, who operates automatically and quickly.
The biases, which influence our judgments, often lead to predictable errors.
Understanding the two systems, whom have different roles, is crucial for decision-making.
The effortful mental activities whose System 2 performs include solving complex problems.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: 'Biases' निर्जीव/अमूर्त चीज़ है , इसलिए इसके लिए Relative Pronoun 'which' का इस्तेमाल सही है। (बाकी विकल्पों में who, whom निर्जीव चीज़ों के लिए गलत तरीके से इस्तेमाल हुए हैं)।

t: What is the meaning of the word "deliberate" in the sentence: "System 2 is the slower, more deliberate mode of thinking."
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Deliberate" का अर्थ होता है जानबूझकर, सोच-समझकर और सावधानी से (Careful and intentional) किया गया काम। Hindi Meaning: सोच-समझकर / जानबूझकर.

t: Choose the best synonym for the word "endorse" in the sentence: "System 2 is more methodical and rational, but it is also lazier-it prefers to endorse the intuitions of System 1 rather than question them."
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Endorse" का अर्थ होता है किसी चीज़ का समर्थन करना या उसे 'मंज़ूरी' (Approve) देना। 'System 2' बिना सवाल किए 'System 1' के विचारों को मंज़ूरी दे देता है। Hindi Meaning: समर्थन करना / मंज़ूरी देना.

t: According to the passage, what is one drawback of System 1 thinking?
o: It always leads to incorrect decisions.
It requires too much mental effort.
It can be prone to biases and snap judgments.
It completely replaces System 2 in decision-making.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज में साफ लिखा है: "System 1 is prone to biases and snap judgments" (यानी सिस्टम 1 आसानी से पक्षपात और बिना सोचे-समझे झटपट फैसले लेने का शिकार हो जाता है)।

p: In today's digital age, mobile phones have become an inseparable part of daily life. While they have revolutionized communication and provided instant access to information, they have also contributed to making modern life more restless and fragmented. People of all ages find themselves constantly checking notifications, replying to messages, and scrolling through endless social media feeds. Excessive mobile use often leads to sleep disturbances, reduced concentration, and increased anxiety levels. Many young people, in particular, struggle to maintain real-life connections, as virtual interactions replace face-to-face conversations. Moreover, the constant pressure to stay updated and respond immediately can make it difficult for individuals to relax and enjoy uninterrupted personal time. Experts suggest setting boundaries for mobile use, such as taking regular breaks and turning off unnecessary notifications. Developing mindful habits and disconnecting from screens, even for a short while each day, can help people regain focus, improve sleep, and restore balance in their lives. In an age of hyper-connectivity, learning to unplug may be the key to a calmer, healthier mind.

t: Which of the following sentences is written in the active voice?
o: Sleep disturbances are often caused by excessive mobile use.
Real-life conversations are being replaced by virtual interactions.
Experts suggest setting boundaries for mobile use.
Notifications are checked constantly by people of all ages.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: इस वाक्य में Subject "Experts" खुद क्रिया "suggest" (सुझाव देना) कर रहा है (Active Voice)। बाकी सब में 'be + V3' (are caused, are being replaced, are checked) पैसिव स्ट्रक्चर है।

t: Convert this sentence to active voice: "Uninterrupted personal time is often disturbed by mobile notifications."
o: Mobile notifications are often disturbing uninterrupted personal time.
Mobile notifications disturb uninterrupted personal time.
Uninterrupted personal time disturbs mobile notifications.
Uninterrupted personal time has been disturbed by mobile notifications.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Is disturbed" (Simple Present Passive) एक्टिव में V1 (disturb) बन जाएगा और Agent (Mobile notifications) Subject बन जाएगा।

t: The word "fragmented" means:
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Fragmented" का अर्थ होता है टुकड़ों में बंटा हुआ या बिखरा हुआ (Broken into pieces)। फोन ने हमारी ज़िंदगी के फोकस को टुकड़ों में बाँट दिया है। Hindi Meaning: खंडित / टुकड़ों में बँटा हुआ.

t: What does "hyper-connectivity" mean in the passage?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Hyper" (अत्यधिक) + "connectivity" (जुड़ाव)। यानी हर समय इंटरनेट या फोन से 'अत्यधिक जुड़े रहना' (Staying connected excessively)। Hindi Meaning: अत्यधिक जुड़ाव.

t: What is the main suggestion given by experts in the passage?
o: Set boundaries and take breaks from mobile use
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज में स्पष्ट लिखा है: "Experts suggest setting boundaries for mobile use, such as taking regular breaks..."

p: Goal setting, when pursued with intentionality, is not merely a motivational slogan-it is a cognitive and behavioral process that catalyzes structured action. While the concept may appear deceptively simple, establishing meaningful personal goals involves self-awareness, foresight, and disciplined execution. One of the primary distinctions between passive desire and purposeful ambition lies in specificity. A vague aspiration such as "I want to be successful" lacks operational clarity, whereas a goal like "I aim to complete a professional certification within six months" provides a measurable and time-bound framework. This clarity fosters accountability and helps individuals gauge their progress objectively. Psychologists emphasize the SMART framework-Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound-as a foundational strategy for effective goal setting. However, even well-formulated goals can falter without intrinsic motivation. When goals are externally imposed or socially conditioned, they often lead to compliance rather than commitment. True sustainability in personal growth arises from internally generated objectives aligned with one's values and long-term vision. Moreover, it is essential to distinguish between outcome goals and process goals. While the former focuses on the final result, the latter centers on daily habits and behavioral consistency. Ironically, it is often process adherence-not obsession with outcomes that leads to long-term accomplishment. Individuals who overfixate on results may experience burnout, especially when success is delayed. Another overlooked dimension is goal flexibility. In a dynamic environment, rigid goal adherence can lead to frustration or irrelevance. Adaptive thinking enables individuals to recalibrate their direction without perceiving it as failure. Reflection, therefore, becomes an integral tool-ensuring that one's aspirations remain context-sensitive and personally meaningful. Ultimately, goal setting is not a singular event but an evolving cycle of intention, action, reflection, and adaptation. When undertaken mindfully, it transforms individuals from passive aspirants to purposeful actors in their own narrative.

t: According to the passage, what is a core reason why vague goals often fail?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज में स्पष्ट रूप से बताया गया है कि "A vague aspiration... lacks operational clarity," (अस्पष्ट लक्ष्यों में यह स्पष्टता नहीं होती कि उन्हें वास्तव में कैसे पूरा किया जाए)।

t: What does the passage suggest about intrinsic motivation?
o: It can be cultivated by reward systems
It is irrelevant in structured planning
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज कहता है कि "True sustainability... arises from internally generated objectives ligned with one's values" (सच्ची प्रेरणा अपनी अंदरूनी मान्यताओं a के 'एलाइनमेंट' से आती है)।

t: What is the main benefit of focusing on process goals over outcome goals?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: 'Process goals' "daily habits and behavioral consistency" पर केंद्रित होते हैं, जिससे व्यक्ति को लंबे समय तक टिके रहने (sustainability) में मदद मिलती है, बिना थके।

t: What role does flexibility play in goal setting, according to the passage?
o: It encourages one to abandon goals easily
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: 'Adaptive thinking' (लचीलापन) व्यक्ति को बिना खुद को असफल माने 'दिशा बदलने' (recalibrate) की आज़ादी देता है (contextual adaptation)।

t: What does the word "catalyzes" in the paragraph most nearly mean?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Catalyze" विज्ञान का एक शब्द है जिसका अर्थ है किसी काम को 'शुरू करना या उसकी रफ़्तार बढ़ाना' (Initiates or accelerates)। Hindi Meaning: गति बढ़ाना / उत्प्रेरित करना.

p: In today's digital world, social media platforms have become an inseparable part of daily life for millions of people. While these platforms help people stay connected, share information, and express their opinions, they also raise serious concerns about data privacy. Every time a user uploads photos, shares posts, or likes content, they leave behind a digital footprint. Social media companies collect this data to show targeted advertisements and improve user experience. However, this information can also be misused if it falls into the wrong hands or if companies fail to protect it properly. Recent cases of data breaches have made people more aware of how vulnerable their personal information can be online. Experts suggest that users should read privacy policies, use strong passwords, and limit the amount of personal information they share on these platforms. Maintaining data privacy is crucial to ensure that social media remains a safe space for everyone.

t: Which word in the passage is a past participle?
q.sr: [SSC Stenographer Grade C & D Examination, 2026, 10 sep 2026, Shift-1]
q.e: In the passage's precise grammatical structure, "connected" functions completely perfectly as a past participle acting as a modifying adjective following the linking verb "stay". Words ending in "-ing" are present participles, while "limit" is a base verb.

t: In the sentence "Recent cases of data breaches have made people more aware of how vulnerable their personal information can be online," what is the tense of the verb phrase "have made", and what does it indicate?
o: Past simple a completed action in the past
Present perfect an action that has relevance to the present
Past perfect an action completed before another past action
q.e: The verbal phrase "have made" strictly utilizes the precise present perfect tense structure. This specific grammatical formation unequivocally signifies an action that occurred in the recent past but maintains direct, heavy continuing relevance to the present state of affairs.

t: The word "breaches" means:
q.e: In the incredibly specific context of cyber data and digital privacy, a "breach" explicitly and strictly refers to an unauthorized break, malicious intrusion, or aggressive violation of security protocols that dangerously exposes highly sensitive personal information.

t: The word "vulnerable" means:
o: At risk of harm or attack
q.e: The defining term "vulnerable" characterizes something that is completely unprotected and highly susceptible to severe physical or emotional attack. Regarding online data privacy, it signifies that personal information is incredibly exposed and profoundly at risk of malicious theft.

p: Driving a vehicle on public roads is a massive responsibility that demands strict adherence to safety regulations. Road accidents have become a leading cause of fatalities globally, many of which are entirely preventable. One of the fundamental rules of driving is maintaining an appropriate speed. Over-speeding reduces a driver’s reaction time and significantly increases the severity of collisions. Consequently, traffic authorities enforce speed limits, and the use of safety gear like seatbelts to reduce risks. Drivers are also advised to avoid distractions like mobile phones while driving, as even a second's carelessness may lead to a disaster.

Equally important is maintaining one's vehicle. A driver who keeps his brakes, headlights, and tires in proper condition ensures not only his safety but also that of others. The roads are shared spaces; therefore, courtesy and discipline are as essential as technical skills. Driving under the influence of alcohol or drugs is strictly prohibited, yet it continues to be a major cause of accidents worldwide. In the future, with the development of advanced technology, cars will become safer and more intelligent. However, no machine can replace human responsibility. If every driver follows rules sincerely, respects pedestrians, and remains alert, the number of road mishaps will decline significantly. Precautions while driving are not just legal requirements; they are moral duties that protect lives.

t: Why does the passage state that "no machine can replace human responsibility" even though future cars will be safer and more intelligent?
o: Because machines are not allowed on all roads
Because pedestrians will not follow rules
Because machines cannot make ethical decisions and drivers must remain alert
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज: भविष्य की कारें अधिक सुरक्षित होंगी, फिर भी कोई मशीन मानवीय ज़िम्मेदारी की जगह नहीं ले सकती, क्योंकि चालक का सतर्क रहना और नैतिक निर्णय लेना ज़रूरी है।

t: What is the primary cause of severe road accidents according to the passage?
o: Driving under the influence of alcohol or drugs
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज: शराब या नशे में गाड़ी चलाना कड़ाई से प्रतिबंधित है, फिर भी यह विश्व भर में दुर्घटनाओं का प्रमुख कारण है।

t: Why is maintaining one's vehicle important according to the author?
o: It helps in selling the car at a higher price
It prevents traffic authorities from checking documents
It ensures the safety of the driver and others
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज: ब्रेक, हेडलाइट और टायर ठीक रखने से चालक और दूसरों दोनों की सुरक्षा सुनिश्चित होती है।

t: What is the overall tone of the passage?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज नियम पालन की सीख और नैतिक कर्तव्य पर ज़ोर देता है, इसलिए इसका लहजा उपदेशात्मक (didactic) है।

t: Select the word that is the most appropriate antonym of "decline" as used in the passage.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: 'Decline' (घटना) का विलोम 'Increase' (बढ़ना) है; Reduce और Decrease समानार्थी हैं। Hindi Meaning: घटना बनाम बढ़ना.

p: In many countries, tough competitive exams have long been seen as the ultimate gateway to prestigious colleges and stable careers. These examinations, which demand years of rigorous preparation, are intended to select only the most capable candidates. However, in recent years, their importance appears to be declining for several reasons. Firstly, an increasing number of students and educators argue that these exams test memory and speed rather than true understanding or creativity. Moreover, the stress and pressure linked with clearing such exams often affect students' mental health negatively. With the rise of alternative evaluation methods, like project-based assessments, skill tests, and holistic interviews, many institutions are reconsidering their over-reliance on traditional exams. Additionally, the rapid growth of online education and professional courses has provided students with alternative pathways to success. Today, employers are placing greater value on practical skills, internships, and real-world problem-solving abilities rather than solely on exam scores. While competitive exams still hold significance, their dominance is slowly fading as the world moves towards more balanced and diverse ways of measuring talent.

t: In the sentence "These examinations, which demand years of rigorous preparation, are intended to select only the most capable candidates," what is the part of speech of the word "rigorous"?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Rigorous" सीधे noun "preparation" से पहले आकर उसे modify करता है और बताता है कि तैयारी कैसी है। जो शब्द noun की विशेषता बताए वह Adjective होता है। यह क्रिया (verb), वस्तु (noun) या दूसरे modifier को बदलने वाला adverb नहीं है। उत्तर (b) Adjective। Hindi Meaning: कठोर / सख़्त।

t: Identify the voice (active or passive) and tense of the verb phrase "are intended" in the sentence: "These examinations, which demand years of rigorous preparation, are intended to select only the most capable candidates."
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Are intended" = "are" (Simple Present का auxiliary) + "intended" (V3)। यह Passive voice है और tense Simple Present है, क्योंकि परीक्षाओं पर "intend" किए जाने की क्रिया हो रही है। Present Perfect Passive "have been intended" होता। Trick: am/is/are + V3 = Simple Present Passive। उत्तर (c)।

t: The word "holistic" means:
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Holistic" ऐसे दृष्टिकोण को कहते हैं जो पूरी तस्वीर को देखे, यानी किसी व्यक्ति या स्थिति के सभी पहलुओं को ध्यान में रखे, सिर्फ़ एक तत्व पर नहीं। "Holistic interviews" उम्मीदवार की पूरी प्रोफ़ाइल परखते हैं, सिर्फ़ परीक्षा के अंक नहीं। "Focused on one part only" इसका antonym है। उत्तर (c)। Hindi Meaning: समग्र / संपूर्ण।

t: In the sentence: "The stress and pressure linked with clearing such exams often affect students' mental health negatively," which of the following is the closest synonym for the word "linked" as used in the sentence?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: यहाँ "linked" तनाव और परीक्षा पास करने की प्रक्रिया के बीच वैचारिक संबंध बताता है, यानी दोनों जुड़े या संबंधित हैं। "Associated with" का अर्थ है किसी चीज़ से जुड़ा या संबंधित होना, जो इसके अर्थ से सबसे ठीक मेल खाता है। उत्तर (c)। Hindi Meaning: जुड़ा हुआ / संबंधित।

t: What is the main idea of the passage?
o: Tough exams are more important than ever
Competitive exams should be made harder
Competitive exams are losing value due to new approaches
All students should avoid exams altogether
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज एक व्यवस्थित तर्क रखता है: वह प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं के पारंपरिक मूल्य को मानता है, पर उनकी कमियों और मूल्यांकन के वैकल्पिक तरीकों के उभार पर लगातार ज़ोर देता है। निष्कर्ष यह है कि परीक्षाएँ "slowly fading" हैं। इसलिए (c) Competitive exams are losing value due to new approaches मुख्य विचार है।

p: In the relentless pursuit of excellence, the dichotomy between hard work and smart work emerges not merely as a matter of preference but as a nuanced dialectic in the broader schema of human productivity. Hard work — often equated with sheer diligence, indefatigable endurance, and linear perseverance — has historically been valorized as the cornerstone of achievement. The laboring individual, armed with nothing but obstinacy and time, is celebrated in folklore and biographies alike. However, in an era punctuated by algorithmic precision and cognitive economy, such traditional notions increasingly invite scrutiny. Contrastingly, smart work embodies a strategic orchestration of effort — an application of metacognition, resource optimization, and situational analysis. It seeks to minimize entropy in labor while maximizing the return on cognitive and physical investment. Smart workers interrogate systems, deconstruct inefficiencies, and leverage available tools — be they digital frameworks or social capital — to expedite outcomes. They transcend the treadmill of unidirectional exertion by inserting intelligence into execution. Nevertheless, the glorification of smart work without the substratum of hard work yields its own inadequacies. Smartness devoid of rigor often culminates in superficiality — a veneer of competence that collapses under sustained demand. Likewise, unmitigated hard work, devoid of strategic redirection, can lead to burnout and inefficacy. Hence, the contemporary paradigm necessitates a confluence: the sagacious worker is one who tempers grit with guile, who labors not just with effort but with efficacy. The juxtaposition, then, is not binary but complementary. To romanticize either extreme is to overlook the variegated realities of performance. In the crucible of modern challenges, the symbiotic blend of persistence and precision is what renders output sustainable and impact magnified. In essence, success is not the fruit of blind toil or cunning alone, but the synthesis of intelligent perseverance.

t: Which of the following best captures the tone of the author in the passage?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: लेखक ने कड़ी मेहनत (hard work) और स्मार्ट वर्क के फायदे-नुकसान का बहुत ही 'विश्लेषणात्मक' (Analytical) मूल्यांकन किया है और अंत में दोनों के मिश्रण को ज़रूरी बताया है।

t: Select the sentence that most clearly presents the limitation of relying solely on smart work.
o: "Smartness devoid of rigor often culminates in superficiality..."
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज साफ़ कहता है कि केवल स्मार्ट वर्क करने से 'छिछलापन या दिखावा' (superficiality) आ जाता है जो लंबे समय तक नहीं टिकता।

t: From a philosophical perspective, what argument does the author make about the dichotomy between hard work and smart work?
o: They must harmonize to achieve sustainable results.
One must dominate the other for success.
Smart work is the only viable path in the modern age.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: लेखक कहता है: "the symbiotic blend of persistence and precision is what renders output sustainable." (लगातार काम और स्मार्ट तरीके के तालमेल से ही स्थायी रिज़ल्ट मिलते हैं)।

t: What does the phrase "minimize entropy in labor" imply in the context of smart work?
o: Eliminate randomness and inefficiency in effort.
Increase workload to achieve results faster.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: 'Entropy' का अर्थ है अव्यवस्था या व्यर्थ ऊर्जा। "Minimize entropy in labor" का मतलब है अपनी मेहनत में से 'अव्यवस्था और अकुशलता को खत्म करना' (Eliminate randomness and inefficiency)। Hindi Meaning: व्यर्थ की मेहनत या अव्यवस्था को कम करना.

t: Which metaphor is used to describe unidirectional exertion?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज में लिखा है: "They transcend the treadmill of unidirectional exertion..." (जैसे ट्रे डमिल पर आप एक ही दिशा में दौड़ते हैं लेकिन पहुँचते कहीं नहीं हैं, स्मार्ट वर्क इस स्थिति से बाहर निकालता है)।

p: Mandala art, a term derived from the Sanskrit word for "circle." Mandalas are mathematical and metaphorical works of art that have captivated people for ages. In essence, a mandala is a circle pattern that represents the cosmos and the individual's journey. The genesis of everything, one's identity, or a heavenly essence are all represented by the design's centre. Complex and often symmetrical patterns spread forth from this hub representing the universe's growth and the continuous flow of life. Mandalas, which have their roots in both Buddhism and Hinduism, are powerful instruments for spiritual ritual and meditation. In order to symbolise the fleeting nature of life and the rejection of earthly possessions, monks painstakingly create these elaborate patterns out of coloured sand, only to brush them away when finished. Making a mandala has therapeutic benefits in addition to its religious significance. Drawing its geometric patterns in a methodical and repeated manner helps to reduce tension, improve focus, and calm the mind. The act of creating is a form of active meditation that allows the artist to concentrate and attain inner peace.

t: What does the term "mandala" mean in Sanskrit?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज की पहली ही लाइन में लिखा है: "derived from the Sanskrit word for 'circle'." Hindi Meaning: वृत्त / गोला.

t: What does the center of a mandala represent?
o: One's identity or a heavenly essence
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज के अनुसार: "The genesis of everything, one's identity, or a heavenly essence are all represented by the design's centre." (डिज़ाइन का केंद्र किसी की पहचान या स्वर्गीय सार का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है)।

t: According to the passage, why do monks create mandalas out of coloured sand?
o: To symbolize the fleeting nature of life
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: भिक्षु (monks) इसे रेत से बनाते हैं और फिर मिटा देते हैं "In order to symbolise the fleeting nature of life" (जीवन की क्षणभंगुरता या नश्वरता को दर्शाने के लिए)।

t: What therapeutic benefits are associated with making a mandala?
o: It helps reduce tension, and calm the mind.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: थेराप्यूटिक (चिकित्सीय) फायदों के बारे में पैसेज कहता है: "helps to reduce tension, improve focus, and calm the mind."

t: What is the primary purpose of mandalas in Buddhist and Hindu traditions?
o: To symbolize the cosmos and the individual's journey
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "a mandala is a circle pattern that represents the cosmos and the individual's journey." (यह ब्रह्मांड और व्यक्ति की आध्यात्मिक यात्रा का प्रतीक है)।

p: Iron and calcium are two indispensable minerals required for the healthy growth of the human body, especially in children and women. Iron plays a crucial role in the production of hemoglobin, the pigment that transports oxygen from the lungs to various tissues. A deficiency of iron often leads to anemia, which is characterized by fatigue, dizziness, and a weakened immune system. In children, this deficiency may also result in delayed cognitive development and poor academic performance. Calcium, on the other hand, is primarily associated with the formation and maintenance of strong bones and teeth. Inadequate calcium intake during childhood hampers skeletal growth, while in women it increases the risk of osteoporosis a condition where bones become porous and fragile. Pregnant and lactating mothers require additional calcium, as their bodies support not only their own needs but also those of the growing child.

The causes of these deficiencies are often linked to poor dietary habits, lack of awareness, and socio-economic factors. Diets deficient in green leafy vegetables, dairy products, and iron-rich foods such as pulses and lean meat significantly contribute to the problem. Therefore, it becomes imperative to encourage balanced nutrition, timely medical check-ups, and awareness campaigns. Only then can society combat the silent yet widespread issue of iron and calcium deficiency, ensuring healthier generations in the future.

t: Identify the correct verb form in the sentence.
"Calcium, on the other hand, ________ primarily associated with the formation and maintenance of strong bones and teeth."
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: कर्ता 'Calcium' एकवचन है और वाक्य सामान्य तथ्य बताता है, इसलिए Simple Present का 'is' आएगा।

t: Identify the type of sentence.
"A deficiency of iron often leads to anemia."
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: वाक्य एक तथ्य बताता है, इसलिए यह कथनात्मक (Declarative) वाक्य है।

t: The word 'indispensable' in the sentence "Iron and calcium are two indispensable minerals required for the healthy growth of the human body..." means
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: 'Indispensable' का अर्थ अनिवार्य / आवश्यक (essential) है। Hindi Meaning: अपरिहार्य.

t: In the sentence "...in women it increases the risk of osteoporosis-a condition where bones become porous and fragile," the antonym of 'fragile' is
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: 'Fragile' (नाज़ुक) का विलोम 'strong' (मजबूत) है; weak, delicate और brittle इसके समानार्थी हैं। Hindi Meaning: नाज़ुक.

t: According to the passage, why do "pregnant and lactating mothers require additional calcium"?
o: Because of their role in household work
Because their bodies support both their own needs and those of the growing child
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज: गर्भवती व स्तनपान कराने वाली माताओं का शरीर अपनी और बढ़ते शिशु दोनों की ज़रूरतें पूरी करता है।

p: In today's fast-paced world, staying fit and healthy has become more important than ever. Regular exercise helps improve physical strength, mental well-being, and overall energy levels. A combination of cardio exercises, such as running or cycling, and strength training can help keep the body in good shape. Apart from exercise, maintaining a balanced diet plays a crucial role in fitness. Eating fresh fruits, vegetables, and protein-rich foods provides essential nutrients for the body. On the other hand, consuming excessive junk food can lead to health problems like obesity and heart disease. Fitness is not just about physical health; it also impacts mental well-being. Regular workouts release endorphins, which help reduce stress and improve mood. Even simple activities like walking or stretching can make a big difference. Staying fit requires dedication and consistency, but the benefits are worth the effort.

t: Choose the correct article to complete the sentence: "Eating __ balanced diet is essential for good health."
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "balanced" शब्द की शुरुआत व्यंजन ध्वनि (consonant sound 'b') से होती है और यह एक आम/सामान्य 'डाइट' की बात कर रहा है, इसलिए इसके आगे 'A' लगेगा (A balanced diet)। Hindi Meaning: एक (संतुलित आहार).

t: Identify the sentence with correct subject-verb agreement:
o: Regular exercises helps in maintaining fitness.
The benefits of daily workouts is numerous.
A balanced diet and exercise are important for health.
Eating junk food lead to health issues.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Option (c) में Subject "A balanced diet and exercise" है, जो 'and' से जुड़कर बहुवचन (Plural) बन गया है, इसलिए इसके साथ Plural verb 'are' का इस्तेमाल बिल्कुल सही है। (बाकी विकल्पों में Singular/Plural की गलती है)।

t: What is the meaning of "endorphins" in the passage?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज में लिखा है: "release endorphins, which help reduce stress and improve mood." इससे साफ होता है कि 'Endorphins' वे हार्मोन हैं जो तनाव को कम करते हैं और मूड को अच्छा करते हैं। Hindi Meaning: तनाव कम करने वाले हार्मोन.

t: Find the synonym of "crucial" from the passage.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Crucial" का मतलब होता है बहुत ज़्यादा ज़रूरी या महत्वपूर्ण (extremely important / decisive)। इसलिए "Important" इसका सबसे अच्छा समानार्थी (Synonym) है। Hindi Meaning: महत्वपूर्ण / अति-आवश्यक.

p: Changes that seem small and unimportant at first will compound into remarkable results if you're willing to stick with them for years. We often convince ourselves that massive success requires massive action. Whether it's losing weight, building a business, or learning a new skill, we put pressure on ourselves to make some earth-shattering improvement that everyone will notice. However, improvement by just 1 percent each day may not be noticeable in the moment, but over time it can be far more meaningful. The same way that money compounds with interest, the effects of your habits multiply as you repeat them. The outcomes you see in your life today are often the result of small choices made over time, rather than dramatic changes. This is why habits are the compound interest of self-improvement. The longer you stick with them, the greater the returns. But just as positive habits can compound in your favor, negative habits can compound against you. A slight slip in discipline today may not seem like a big deal, but if repeated, it can steer you in a completely different direction. Success, then, is not a single event-it is the result of daily choices, made consistently over time.

t: What is the best meaning of "compound" in the sentence: "Changes that seem small and unimportant at first will compound into remarkable results if you're willing to stick with them for years."
o: To accumulate and grow over time
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: 'Compound' (चक्रवृद्धि) का अर्थ यहाँ है समय के साथ धीरे -धीरे जमा होना और एक बड़ा परिणाम देना (जैसे बैंक में Compound Interest बढ़ता है)। Hindi Meaning: समय के साथ इकट्ठा होकर बढ़ना.

t: Choose the best antonym for the word "discipline" in the sentence: "A slight slip in discipline today may not seem like a big deal, but if repeated, it can steer you in a completely different direction."
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Discipline" (अनुशासन) का अर्थ है खुद पर नियंत्रण और नियमों का पालन। इसका विलोम (Antonym) "Carelessness" (लापरवाही) होगा, जिसका अर्थ है बिना ध्यान दिए काम करना। बाकी सभी (Commitment, Focus) इसके समानार्थी हैं। Hindi Meaning: अनुशासन -> लापरवाही.

p: Special children are those who have physical, emotional, or learning differences that make their development unique. These children may face challenges in communication, movement, social interaction, or understanding academic concepts. However, with proper care, support, and inclusive education, they can thrive and lead fulfilling lives. In recent years, there has been a growing shift in society's attitude towards special children. Instead of isolating or ignoring them, schools and communities are now working towards inclusion — providing opportunities for them to learn and grow alongside other children. Educators receive special training, and classrooms are being equipped with tools and technologies to support diverse needs. Parents, too, play a vital role in the development of special children. Encouragement, patience, and emotional support can help build confidence in these children. Society must continue to create environments where every child, regardless of their abilities, feels respected, valued, and capable.

t: Identify the correct form of the verb: "Special children are those who ___ physical, emotional, or learning differences that make their development unique."
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Relative pronoun "who" बहुवचन antecedent "children" की ओर इशारा करता है। बहुवचन subject के साथ बहुवचन verb आती है और Present Tense का सही रूप "have" है। "Has" एकवचन है, "Had" भूतकाल है और "Having" participle है, इसलिए कोई भी plural present से मेल नहीं खाता। उत्तर (a) have।

t: Choose the correct preposition: "However, ___ proper care, support, and inclusive education, they can thrive and lead fulfilling lives."
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "With" साथ होने या किसी साधन के सहारे परिणाम पाने का भाव देता है, इसलिए "with proper care" का मतलब उचित देखभाल होने पर। "By" तरीक़ा बताता, "At" स्थान बताता और "On" यहाँ मुहावरे के अनुसार सही नहीं है। Trick: साथ/सहायता के भाव में With। उत्तर (b)।

t: The word "inclusive" means:
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Inclusive" ऐसी व्यवस्था को कहते हैं जो पृष्ठभूमि, क्षमता या पहचान की परवाह किए बिना सभी को स्वीकार करे और जगह दे। इसलिए (a) Allowing everyone to participate सही है। "Only for selected people" इसका सीधा उलटा, यानी exclusive है। Hindi Meaning: समावेशी।

t: The word "thrive" most likely means:
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Thrive" का अर्थ है अनुकूल माहौल में ज़ोर से बढ़ना और फलना-फूलना। "Grow successfully" इसका सबसे सटीक रूप है। "Fail to improve" और "Remain stuck" इसके antonyms हैं और "Stay quiet" का इससे कोई संबंध नहीं। उत्तर (c)। Hindi Meaning: फलना-फूलना।

t: What is the main message of the passage?
o: Special children should be taught separately
Society should support and include special children
Parents should let special children stay at home
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज लगातार inclusive education, कक्षा में तकनीकी सहयोग और माता-पिता के प्रोत्साहन की वकालत करता है। केंद्रीय बात यह है कि समाज को ऐसे सहयोगी और समावेशी माहौल बनाने चाहिए जहाँ special children सम्मानित और मूल्यवान महसूस करें, यानी अलगाव के बिल्कुल उलट। उत्तर (b)।

p: For seventeen-year-old Meera, adolescence was not merely a phase of hormonal transitions and academic aspirations — it became an arena where perception and self-worth collided with insidious intensity. In a world saturated with curated digital aesthetics and algorithm-driven beauty hierarchies, Meera's own reflection began to feel less like truth and more like betrayal. Every scroll through her social media feed deepened a gnawing dissonance: between her authentic self and the impossible silhouettes idolized online. This wasn't mere teenage insecurity — it manifested as a systematic devaluation of her physical self. Gradually, she adopted punitive behaviors: food became conditional, mirrors became adversaries, and compliments transformed into cryptic reminders of inadequacy. The subtle descent into dysmorphia was neither loud nor linear. Academically capable and socially pleasant, Meera wore the mask of normalcy with precision. Yet beneath the practiced smiles was a quiet implosion. She began withdrawing emotionally, rationalizing her distress as vanity, and trivializing her worth. The turning point came not with drama, but with silence — a refusal to eat for days, which led to medical intervention. Therapeutic engagement introduced her to the concept of self-image distortion, and the emotional scaffolding required to rebuild her fractured sense of identity. Through sustained counseling, Meera disentangled societal impositions from intrinsic value. She began to internalize that beauty is not a monolith dictated by culture but a spectrum shaped by diversity, health, and self-compassion. Meera's narrative is not a singular anomaly but a mirror to a larger epidemic — where teenagers battle unspoken wars behind flawless digital façades. Combating this requires more than awareness; it calls for critical media literacy, empathetic environments, and systemic redefinition of beauty norms that extend beyond superficial metrics.

t: What does the phrase "gnawing dissonance" in the passage most likely refer to?
o: Her hunger due to skipped meals
Conflict between her inner worth and online ideals
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Gnawing dissonance" का अर्थ है वह लगातार चुभने वाला 'टकराव या अंतर्विरोध' जो उसकी असली पहचान और इंटरनेट पर दिखने वाले नकली 'आदर्शों' (impossible silhouettes) के बीच था।

t: How does the passage describe Meera's psychological decline?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज में कहा गया है कि उसका पतन "neither loud nor linear" था और वह अंदर ही अंदर टूट रही थी ("quiet implosion")। इसका अर्थ है कि यह बहुत ही 'सूक्ष्म और अंदर से खोखला करने वाला' (subtle and inwardly destructive) था।

t: What concept helped Meera begin recovering emotionally?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: थेरेपी (Therapeutic engagement) ने उसे "concept of self-image distortion" से परिचित कराया, जिससे उसे ठीक होने में मदद मिली।

t: Which of the following best captures the central theme of the passage?
o: The influence of peer pressure on teens
Cosmetic beauty norms and fashion trends
Hidden psychological battles due to digital aesthetics
The necessity of academic counseling for teens
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज की अंतिम लाइनें इस बात का सार देती हैं कि कैसे टीनेजर्स "flawless digital façades" के पीछे छिपी हुई मानसिक लड़ाइयां (unspoken wars) लड़ रहे हैं।

t: What is the tone of the author at the end of the paragraph?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: अंत में लेखक समाज की झूठी सुंदरता के पैमानों पर 'विचार' (Reflective) करता है और मीडिया तथा समाज की 'आलोचना' (Critical) करते हुए बदलाव की मांग करता है।

p: William Shakespeare's famous tragedy, King Lear, explores what happens when pride, misplaced trust, and family problems go unchecked. The story follows Lear, an old King of Britain, who gives up his throne and divides his kingdom among his three daughters, based on how much they flatter him. The two older sisters flatter Lear to get the biggest share, but the youngest, Cordelia, refuses to exaggerate her love and chooses to be honest. Lear, upset by her response, sends Cordelia away and dismisses the wise advisers who tried to help him. But then, the conniving sisters get hold of all that power and kick their father out, treating him disgustingly in his old age. Stripped of everything, Lear ends up outside during a fierce storm. Madness sets in as reality hits him hard-he's lost everything due to his silly fantasies. At its core, this tale warns us about how the ego can shatter a family and cause total destruction.

t: What is the main theme of the passage?
q.sr: [SSC Stenographer Grade C & D 2026, 12 Sep 2026, Shift-2]
o: The destructive impact of ego and false trust on family.
The political strategies used to expand early British territories.
The historical lifestyle differences between royal siblings.
The economic advantages of retiring early from public office.
q.e: The passage summarizes this effectively in the closing line: "At its core, this tale warns us about how the ego can shatter a family and cause total destruction," directly establishing the destructive impact of ego and misplaced trust as the primary theme.

t: According to the passage, on what basis does King Lear decide to divide his kingdom?
o: The chronological age and wisdom of his three daughters.
The amount of flattery and praise his daughters offer him.
The financial needs of each daughter's separate household.
The recommendations given by his professional military advisors.
q.e: The passage explicitly states that Lear "gives up his throne and divides his kingdom among his three daughters, based on how much they flatter him."

t: What can be inferred about Lear's two older sisters from their behaviour?
o: While loyal to the kingdom, they harbour intense dislike for Cordelia.
Their deep concern centres on their father's physical health.
They are manipulative and use false praise purely to gain political power.
Once their father's madness passes, they plan a return to the throne.
q.e: The passage describes them as "conniving sisters" who "flatter Lear to get the biggest share," and then immediately "kick their father out" once they get hold of the power. This demonstrates pure political manipulation.

t: Based on the passage, what triggers King Lear's descent into madness?
o: Learning that Cordelia has successfully raised a foreign army.
Being forced to fight an aggressive war against his wise advisers.
A sudden financial crisis that wiped out the kingdom's wealth.
Realising he has lost everything because of his own foolish illusions.
q.e: The passage notes that "Madness sets in as reality hits him hard-he's lost everything due to his silly fantasies," directly pointing to his sudden realization of his own foolish, ego-driven mistakes.

t: What does the "fierce storm" experience highlight about Lear's situation at that point in the play?
o: His total political victory over his conniving children.
His complete loss of power, shelter, and royal dignity.
His successful journey to find Cordelia in another land.
His complete lack of interest in what his daughters did to him.
q.e: The storm is the physical setting where Lear is described as being "Stripped of everything," ending up entirely alone "outside." It acts as a dramatic symbol of his total loss of royal authority, basic shelter, and dignity.

p: 'The Movement' group was formed against the elitism of The Bloomsbury and Bohemia groups. These poets wrote ironical verses that celebrated the idea of English identity and were often immersed with nostalgia. The group included the novelist Kingsley Amis, the poet-novelist John Wain, poet-critic Donald Davie, poets Elizabeth Jennings, Thom Gunn, John Wain, D. J. Enright and Robert Conquest. The title 'the Movement' was coined by J. D. Scott, literary editor of The Spectator. This group shared antipathy towards the cultural pretensions of the Bohemian and the Bloomsbury group and in general, they had the disapproval of the elitism of the modernist writings. The writers of this group were identified by their class Origins, beer-drinking and pipe smoking habits.

t: What were the reasons for the establishment of 'The Movement' group in Britain?
o: Modernist elitism was advocated, and experimental writing styles were in the limelight
Romantic ideals were revived, and irony in poetry was completely rejected
Avant-garde art and radical political movements were encouraged instead
The oppositions were against the cultural pretensions and elitism of the Bloomsbury and Bohemian groups
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज: 'The Movement' समूह ब्लूम्सबरी और बोहेमियन समूहों के अभिजात्य (elitism) और सांस्कृतिक दिखावे के विरोध में बना।

t: Who coined the term 'The Movement'?
o: Kingsley Amis, one of the leading novelists of the group
Donald Davie, poet-critic and member of the group
Robert Conquest, known for his satirical verses
J. D. Scott, literary editor of The Spectator
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज: 'the Movement' नाम स्पेक्टेटर के साहित्य संपादक जे.डी. स्कॉट ने दिया।

t: Which of the following best describes the style and themes of The Movement poets?
o: Very much influenced by the European avant-garde, they were highly experimental and abstract.
The main themes were surrealist images and radical political propaganda.
The poets were completely engrossed in the revival of medieval forms and themes related to religion.
Their poetry was ironic, nostalgic, and identity-rooted, rejecting often the pretentious elitism.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: इनकी कविता व्यंग्यपूर्ण, नॉस्टैल्जिक और अंग्रेज़ी पहचान से जुड़ी थी तथा दिखावटी अभिजात्य को नकारती थी।

t: How were The Movement writers often identified socially and culturally?
o: Through their working-class origins and radical political activism
Through their connection with cosmopolitan intellectual circles and experimental art
By their aristocratic background and preference for the elite salon
Through their middle-class roots, beer-drinking, and pipe-smoking habits
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज: इन लेखकों की पहचान उनकी वर्गीय पृष्ठभूमि, बीयर पीने और पाइप पीने की आदतों से होती थी।

t: What attitude did The Movement writers share toward modernist literature?
o: They accepted the use of avant-garde techniques and denounced the English identity based on tradition.
They turned away from irony and nostalgia, concentrating exclusively on abstract philosophical discussions.
They appreciated its intricacy and sought to experiment likewise through their writing.
They looked down upon its elitist nature and cultural pretensions, choosing clarity and accessibility in writing.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज: वे आधुनिकतावादी लेखन के अभिजात्य और सांस्कृतिक दिखावे के विरोधी थे।

p: Engineering was once considered one of the most prestigious and secure career choices in India. For decades, thousands of students competed fiercely to enter top engineering colleges, believing that a degree would guarantee a stable job and a prosperous future. However, in recent years, this perception has started to change dramatically. One of the main reasons for the decline in scope is the oversaturation of engineering graduates. With hundreds of private colleges producing lakhs of engineers every year, the job market cannot absorb them all. As a result, many graduates remain unemployed or are forced to accept jobs unrelated to their field of study. Additionally, rapid technological changes demand new skills that traditional curriculums often fail to provide, leaving graduates underprepared for modern industry requirements. Moreover, industries now prefer candidates with practical knowledge and specialised skills over generic degrees. While there are still opportunities in emerging fields like Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, and Data Science, they require constant upskilling and innovation. Thus, unless the education system reforms its approach and students focus on skill-based learning, the scope for conventional engineering will continue to shrink.

t: In the sentence: "Engineering was once considered one of the most prestigious and secure career choices in India," what is the tense of the verb "was considered"?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Was considered" = was + V3। यह Simple Past Tense का Passive Voice रूप है। (Past Perfect के लिए 'had been considered' होना चाहिए था)।

t: In the sentence: "Moreover, industries now prefer candidates with practical knowledge and specialised skills over generic degrees," why is the verb "prefer" used and not "prefers"?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: वाक्य का Subject "industries" (बहुवचन/Plural) है। नियम के अनुसार बहुवचन कर्ता के साथ क्रिया की Base form (prefer) आती है, उसमें 's/es' (prefers) नहीं लगता।

t: The word "oversaturation" means:
o: Too many graduates for available jobs
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: 'Oversaturation' का मतलब है क्षमता से अधिक भर जाना (supply exceeding demand)। यहाँ नौकरियों की तुलना में इंजीनियरों की संख्या बहुत ज़्यादा हो गई है। Hindi Meaning: अति-संतृप्ति / ज़रूरत से ज़्यादा भर जाना.

t: The word "upskilling" means:
o: Improving skills to match new demands
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: 'Up-skilling' का अर्थ होता है समय और बाज़ार की नई माँगों के अनुसार अपने कौशल (skills) को अपग्रेड करना या सुधारना। Hindi Meaning: कौशल बढ़ाना / नया हुनर सीखना.

t: According to the passage, what is a major reason for limited scope in engineering today?
o: Too many graduates and outdated education
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज में स्कोप कम होने के दो बड़े कारण दिए गए हैं: 1. Oversaturation (बहुत ज़्यादा ग्रेजुएट्स) 2. Traditional curriculums fail to provide new skills (पुराना/आउटडेटेड सिलेबस)।

p: Cricket, as a sport, has continually evolved in response to changing audience preferences and technological advancements. Among its many formats, Test cricket and One Day Internationals (ODIs) represent two contrasting philosophies — one rooted in endurance and strategy, the other in dynamism and entertainment. Test cricket, often regarded as the pinnacle of the sport, is a format that unfolds over five days, demanding exceptional levels of patience, technique, and mental resilience. It offers players the opportunity to exhibit classical skills and tactical acumen, where the fluctuating tempo mirrors the rhythm of real life — unpredictable, slow-burning, and layered. For purists, Test cricket is an art form, rewarding not merely flamboyance but consistency and grit. In contrast, ODIs compress the drama into a single day. With limited overs, this format prioritizes aggressive batting, innovative bowling variations, and strategic field placements. The adrenaline-infused pace of ODIs appeals to a broader demographic, especially in an era of dwindling attention spans and time constraints. For broadcasters and advertisers, the shorter format offers commercial viability, making it a lucrative spectacle. However, critics argue that the commercialization of ODIs has come at the expense of depth and nuance. In pursuit of viewership, substance often gives way to spectacle. Conversely, defenders of Test cricket lament its declining audience, attributing it to an increasingly entertainment-driven sports culture. Yet, occasional high-stakes encounters — like the Ashes or India-Australia series — still manage to ignite global interest. The ongoing debate between formats is not merely about preference, but about the identity of the sport itself. While both formats have their merits, the challenge lies in preserving the sanctity of Test cricket without undermining the accessibility of ODIs — a delicate balance that cricketing authorities must negotiate in the years ahead.

t: Which of the following best captures the essence of Test cricket, as described in the passage?
o: It is long and often boring
It includes domestic and emotional elements
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: टेस्ट क्रिकेट के बारे में लिखा है : "mirrors the rhythm of real life — unpredictable, slow-burning, and layered (complex)." (यह असली ज़िंदगी की तरह अप्रत्याशित और जटिल है)।

t: Which of the following is a criticism of ODIs mentioned in the passage?
o: Loss of depth due to over-commercialization
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: ODI की आलोचना करते हुए आलोचक कहते हैं कि "commercialization of ODIs has come at the expense of depth and nuance." (पैसे कमाने के चक्कर में खेल की गहराई खत्म हो गई है)।

t: How are Test cricket and ODIs contrasted in terms of viewer appeal?
o: Tests are faster and more entertaining
ODIs are only popular among senior fans
ODIs cater to shorter attention spans
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: दर्शकों की पसंद के मामले में ODI इसलिए मशहूर है क्योंकि आज के ज़माने में लोगों के पास समय कम है और उनका "attention span" (ध्यान देने की अवधि) छोटी हो गई है।

t: What tone does the author adopt toward the preservation of Test cricket?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: लेखक टेस्ट क्रिकेट के घटते दर्शकों पर 'आलोचनात्मक' (critical) है, लेकिन साथ ही एशेज जैसी सीरीज़ देखकर उसे 'उम्मीद' (hopeful) भी है कि यह ज़िंदा रहेगा।

t: What is the central concern raised in the passage?
o: Lack of good players for both formats
Reducing cricket formats to two only
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज की बिल्कुल आखिरी लाइन में मूल चिंता छिपी है: "preserving the sanctity of Test cricket (tradition) without undermining the accessibility of ODIs (commercial interests)".

p: Antonin Artaud was associated with Surrealism and avant-garde theatre. His eventual departure from Surrealism made him develop the Theatre of Cruelty and publish its theories in the work called Theatre and Its Double. He removed the barrier between the performers and the audience. He made use of oversized props, lightning effects, groans, screams and verbal incantations to strike the audience's emotions and senses with an array of technical effects in order to make them face the unreal, ugly and grotesque pain. The whole idea of the theatre of cruelty was to leave a lasting impact on the psychology of the audience.

t: What led Antonin Artaud to develop the Theatre of Cruelty?
o: His rejection of traditional realism and his desire to create a theatre based on calm, reflective storytelling
His interest in psychological naturalism inspired by Stanislavsky's methods of acting
His attempt to revive classical Greek theatre and restore its poetic structure
His departure from Surrealism, which pushed him toward formulating a radical, sensory-driven performance style
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज: सररियलिज़्म छोड़ने के बाद आर्तो ने Theatre of Cruelty विकसित किया, जो उग्र इंद्रिय-आधारित प्रदर्शन शैली थी।

t: What was one of the central goals of Artaud's Theatre of Cruelty?
o: To continue the illusion of a realistic world on the stage
To produce touching drama that concerned only the emotions of the characters
To shock the audience out of passive viewing and provoke a psychological response
To amuse spectators with humorous comedy and clever dialogue
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Theatre of Cruelty का लक्ष्य दर्शकों के मन पर स्थायी प्रभाव छोड़ना और उन्हें निष्क्रिय दर्शन से झकझोरकर मनोवैज्ञानिक प्रतिक्रिया जगाना था।

t: How did Artaud redefine the relationship between performer and audience?
o: By having actors stay only on the stage to keep a sense of distance
By taking away barriers and putting performers right among the audience
By using heavy curtains and screens to separate the space and prevent distractions
By saying the audience should stay passive during the performance
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज: आर्तो ने कलाकारों और दर्शकों के बीच की दीवार हटा दी।

t: Which elements of stagecraft did Artaud use to create his intense sensory environment?
o: Giant props, sudden lights, and loud noises, with shouting and singing
Opera music, real-looking props, and life-like lighting to keep the old theatre styles
Fragile symbolic movements and silent talking to stir minor emotional changes
Little light, quiet voices, and a simple visual design to make a meditative calm
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज: विशाल प्रॉप्स, चकाचौंध करने वाली रोशनी, कराहें, चीखें और मंत्रोच्चार।

t: What was the final effect desired by Artaud with his Theatre of Cruelty?
o: A soft, self-searching experience that lets people be calm and amused by the plot
A total perceptual experience that was merely concerned with the elements of beauty and harmony
A revival of the classical traditions alongside the use of familiar dramatic forms
A permanent mental impact that compels the public to face the hard truths
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज: उद्देश्य दर्शकों के मनोविज्ञान पर स्थायी प्रभाव छोड़ना था, जो उन्हें कठोर सच्चाइयों का सामना कराए।
