p: Silver ornaments have been a part of women's jewellery collections for centuries, admired for their beauty and affordability. In many cultures, wearing silver is not just a fashion statement but is also believed to have certain health benefits. Some traditional beliefs suggest that silver can help in regulating body temperature, improving blood circulation, and even protecting the wearer from infections due to its natural antibacterial properties. However, not everyone agrees that wearing silver is entirely good. Poor quality silver or artificial alloys may cause skin allergies or rashes for people with sensitive skin. Additionally, excessive wearing of heavy silver jewellery can sometimes cause discomfort or strain, especially for women who wear large pieces for long durations. Therefore, while silver ornaments can enhance a woman's style and may offer minor health benefits, it is important to ensure the purity of silver and wear it in moderation. Choosing good quality pieces and maintaining hygiene can help women enjoy the beauty of silver without any harmful side effects.

t: In the sentence "Silver ornaments have been a part of women's jewellery collections for centuries..." why is the verb "have" used instead of "has"?
o: Because the sentence is in passive voice
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: वाक्य का मुख्य Subject "ornaments" (आभूषण) है जो कि Plural (बहुवचन) है। इसलिए इसके साथ बहुवचन सहायक क्रिया "have" का प्रयोग हुआ है, न कि 'has' का।

t: In the sentence "...it is important to ensure the purity of silver and wear it in moderation," what is the function of the article "the" before "purity"?
o: It refers to a specific known purity
It is used by mistake and should be removed
It is used to generalize the idea of purity
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "The purity" में Definite Article 'The' का प्रयोग इसलिए हुआ है क्योंकि हम किसी आम शुद्धता कीनहीं, बल्कि 'विशेष रूप से चाँदी की शुद्धता' (purity of silver) की बात कर रहे हैं।

t: The word "alloys" means:
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: 'Alloy' (मिश्र धातु) का अर्थ होता है दो या दो से अधिक धातुओं का 'मिश्रण' (Mixtures of metals), जिसे कठोरता या अन्य गुणों के लिए बनाया जाता है। Hindi Meaning: मिश्र धातु / धातुओं का मिश्रण.

t: The word "moderation" means:
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Moderation" (संयम) का अर्थ है किसी चीज़ का अति न करना—यानी 'सीमित और संतुलित उपयोग' (Limited and balanced use)। Hindi Meaning: संयम / संतुलित उपयोग.

t: What is the main idea of the passage?
o: Silver jewellery should never be worn
Wearing gold is better than silver
Wearing silver has benefits but should be done carefully
Only artificial silver is good for women
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज चाँदी पहनने के फायदों (सस्ता, एंटीबैक्टीरियल) और नुकसानों (स्किन एलर्जी) दोनों पर बात करता है और अंत में कहता है कि इसे अच्छी क्वालिटी का और सावधानी से पहनना चाहिए।

p: In a small village, a government school has become an example of clean energy use. The school uses solar panels to run fans, lights, and even computers. This helps the school save money on electricity bills. The saved money is used to buy books and improve classrooms. The teachers also explain to students how solar energy works and why it is good for the planet. Students learn that solar power does not cause pollution like coal or petrol. The school has also inspired nearby houses to install solar panels. This change has made the village cleaner and more aware of the environment. Even on cloudy days, the solar battery stores enough power to keep the school running. With small steps like this, more schools and homes can help protect nature and build a better future.

t: What energy source does the school use?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज की दूसरी लाइन है: "The school uses solar panels to run fans..." यानी स्कूल 'सौर ऊर्जा' (Solar energy) का इस्तेमाल करता है।

t: What does the school do with saved electricity money?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज में सीधा लिखा है: "The saved money is used to buy books and improve classrooms."

t: Why is solar energy better than coal?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज के अनुसार: "solar power does not cause pollution like coal or petrol." (यह प्रदूषण नहीं फैलाती)।

t: What did the school inspire villagers to do?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज में लिखा है: "The school has also inspired nearby houses to install solar panels."

t: What helps the school on cloudy days?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज के अंत में है: "Even on cloudy days, the solar battery stores enough power..." (बादलों वाले दिन सोलर बैटरी काम आती है)।

p: Hospitals operate around the clock, and so do the people who work within them. From doctors and nurses to cleaning staff, lab technicians, and administrative workers, every hospital employee plays a critical role in keeping the system functioning smoothly. While the public often sees doctors as the face of healthcare, the tireless contributions of other workers often go unnoticed. The life of a hospital employee is marked by long hours, high stress, and emotional strain. Nurses may have to attend to critical patients for entire shifts without rest, while housekeeping staff ensure that hygiene standards are maintained to prevent infections. Hospital employees handle hundreds of samples daily with precision, and emergency ward staff often face life-or-death situations multiple times a day. What makes their jobs even more challenging is the emotional burden. Hospital employees witness suffering, grief, and loss more frequently than most people do in a lifetime. Yet, despite the psychological weight, many remain committed to their work out of a deep sense of duty and compassion. In recent years, especially after the COVID-19 pandemic, awareness about the importance of every hospital worker has grown. However, proper recognition, mental health support, and fair working conditions are still essential to ensure the well-being of those who care for others.

t: Which sentence from the passage is written in the present perfect tense?
o: Every hospital employee plays a critical role.
Many remain committed to their work.
Awareness about the importance of every hospital worker has grown.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Present Perfect Tense की पहचान Has/Have + Past Participle (V3) होती है। "Has grown" इसका एकदम सही उदाहरण है। बाकी सभी विकल्प Simple Present Tense (operate, plays, remain) में हैं।

t: Which sentence from the passage contains a modal verb?
o: Nurses may have to attend to critical patients for entire shifts without rest.
Emergency ward staff often faces life-or-death situations.
The life of a hospital employee is marked by long hours.
Hospital employees witness suffering, grief, and loss.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Modal verbs संभावना, क्षमता या आवश्यकता (possibility, ability, necessity) दर्शाते हैं। विकल्प (a) में "may" एक Modal verb है जो संभावना दर्शा रहा है।

t: What does the word "strain" mean in the context of "...high stress, and emotional strain"?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Strain" के कई अर्थ होते हैं (जैसे मांसपेशियों में खिंचाव), लेकिन "emotional strain" के संदर्भ में इसका अर्थ 'गंभीर मानसिक या भावनात्मक दबाव' (mental pressure) होता है। Hindi Meaning: मानसिक तनाव / दबाव.

t: In the sentence "What makes their jobs even more challenging is the emotional burden." What does the word "burden" most closely imply?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Burden" का शाब्दिक अर्थ होता है 'भारी बोझ'। यहाँ 'emotional burden' का मतलब है रोज़ाना दुख और मौत देखकर पड़ने वाला "भारी मानसिक या भावनात्मक बोझ" (A heavy emotional load)। Hindi Meaning: भारी भावनात्मक बोझ.

t: What is the main message of the passage?
o: Doctors are the only essential workers in a hospital
Hospital employees enjoy easy working hours
Hospital employees need recognition and support
Working in a hospital is fun and relaxing
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज अस्पताल के सभी कर्मचारियों (नर्स, क्लीनर आदि) के शारीरिक और मानसिक तनाव को उजागर करता है और अंत में कहता है कि उन्हें 'सम्मान और सपोर्ट' की ज़रूरत है।

p: To bifurcate life into immutable dichotomies of joy and sorrow is to misread its most intrinsic rhythm. Human existence unfolds not as a linear progression of happiness or despair, but as a dynamic interplay where each emotion deepens the resonance of the other. The ecstasy of triumph is never as poignant as when preceded by failure; likewise, the pang of loss finds contour only because we have once cherished the presence of what is now absent. Joy and sorrow, then, are not adversaries but co-authors of the same narrative. From antiquity to modernity, philosophical traditions have acknowledged this existential polarity. The Stoics embraced the inevitability of suffering as a precursor to tranquility, while Eastern philosophies like Buddhism anchor themselves in the impermanence of all experiences. In both frameworks, the pursuit of enduring happiness necessitates an acceptance of transience. Without sorrow, joy would be indistinct — a flat and shallow sensation lacking contrast or value. This interdependence is vividly manifest in the mundane. The delight of spring is intensified by the memory of a harsh winter; the serenity of solitude is meaningful only to one who has tasted the cacophony of crowds. Even our personal growth often emerges from crucibles of pain — grief chisels depth into our emotional landscape, refining our capacity for empathy, resilience, and gratitude. To demand unbroken happiness is to seek a monochromatic life — an existence devoid of emotional texture. The beauty of being lies not in circumventing sorrow, but in embracing it as a necessary foil to joy. These twin sentiments coalesce to form the chiaroscuro of consciousness, rendering our lives more vivid, more intricate, more human.

t: Which of the following best completes the analogy: Joy is to presence as sorrow is to _____?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज कहता है कि हमें दुःख इसलिए होता है क्योंकि हमने "presence of what is now absent" (उसकी मौजूदगी को चाहा था जो अब 'अनुपस्थित' है)। इसलिए Joy=Presence, तो Sorrow=Absence।

t: Based on the passage, what can be reasonably inferred about the author's perspective on human emotions?
o: Life should be devoid of emotional pain
Sorrow deepens the meaning of joy
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Without sorrow, joy would be indistinct" (दुःख के बिना खुशी का कोई मोल नहीं है)। यानी दुःख ही खुशी के मायने को गहरा करता है।

t: What is the author's primary purpose in writing this passage?
o: To argue that sorrow should be embraced as essential to experiencing true joy
To lament the fragility of happiness
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: लेखक का मुख्य उद्देश्य यही समझाना है कि दुःख से भागने (circumventing) के बजाय, उसे खुशी के एक ज़रूरी हिस्से के रूप में अपनाना (embracing) चाहिए।

t: What tone does the author primarily adopt throughout the passage?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज में Stoics, Buddhism, अस्तित्व (existence), और जीवन की गहराइयों का ज़िक्र है, जो इसे एक पूरी तरह से 'दार्शनिक' (Philosophical) टोन देता है।

t: In the context of the passage, what does the word chiaroscuro most likely mean?
o: A blend of light and shadow
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: 'Chiaroscuro' एक आर्ट टर्म है जिसका मतलब है पेंटिंग में 'प्रकाश और छाया का खेल' (blend of light and shadow)। लेखक ने इसे खुशी (रोशनी) और दुःख (अँधेरे) के मिश्रण को समझाने के लिए इस्तेमाल किया है।

p: Yann Martel's Life of Pi explores deep ideas concerning survival, faith, and how we construct the realities we tell ourselves. At its core, the story examines how people handle raw, natural struggles for survival, such as when Pi shares a lifeboat with the fearsome Richard Parker after their voyage goes horribly wrong. This experience shows Pi's split self-the sophisticated part of him and his raw survival instincts clashing while he fights to stay alive. Moreover, Martel questions what someone can believe during desperate times. Pi takes comfort by exploring three religions-Hinduism, Christianity, and Islam-to shield himself from hopelessness. In the end, though, Pi plays with the definition of truth. He ends up telling two entirely different versions of his tale and urges the reader to ponder which is more truthful. So, Martel asserts that we shape our truths based on the accounts we latch onto rather than on cold, hard facts. Such stories help us find purpose in our lives and make sense of everything that happens to us.

t: According to the passage, what does Richard Parker's presence on the lifeboat signify in Pi's internal struggle?
q.sr: [SSC Stenographer Grade C & D 2026, 09 Sep 2026, Shift-2]
o: The conflict between Pi's refined side and his basic survival instincts.
The real threat is animals disappearing from the Pacific Ocean.
The historic change in how zoos were run during colonial India.
The actual need to keep the tiger alive to stay safe on the lifeboat.
q.e: The passage explicitly states that sharing the lifeboat with Richard Parker "shows Pi's split self-the sophisticated part of him and his raw survival instincts clashing while he fights to stay alive." The other options represent disconnected or entirely fabricated themes.

t: Why does Pi explore Hinduism, Christianity, and Islam according to the text?
o: To earn a degree in comparative theology from a Canadian university.
To find a spiritual defense mechanism against hopelessness and despair.
To impress the investigators who were questioning him in Mexico.
To resolve a debate between his family members back in India.
q.e: According to the text, Pi actively seeks comfort by exploring these three major religions "to shield himself from hopelessness." It serves strictly as a spiritual coping mechanism during his desperate time, rejecting the other choices which are irrelevant.

t: What does the passage suggest about the nature of "truth" in Life of Pi?
o: Truth is only based on facts that can be proven and checked.
Truth is impossible to determine because Pi suffered from permanent memory loss.
Truth is a malleable concept shaped by the narratives we choose to believe.
The investigators who record the shipwreck always find out the truth.
q.e: The passage firmly states that "Martel asserts that we shape our truths based on the accounts we latch onto rather than on cold, hard facts." This confirms that truth, within the novel's thematic framework, is subjective and heavily narrative-driven.

t: What is the author's primary goal in presenting two different versions of Pi's survival story?
o: To mislead the reader so they lose interest in the plot.
To demonstrate that the second version is the only historically accurate one
To reveal that Pi lied to conceal a crime
To compel the reader to evaluate the meaning and purpose behind storytelling.
q.e: By telling two entirely different versions of the tale, Pi "urges the reader to ponder which is more truthful." This narrative technique forces the reader to evaluate how storytelling helps us "make sense of everything that happens to us."

t: In the passage, the author uses the term "fearsome" to describe Richard Parker. Which word best acts as a synonym for "fearsome" in this context?
q.e: The word "fearsome" translates to causing fear, especially because of sheer size, power, or ferocity. "Formidable," which means inspiring fear or deep respect through being impressively large, powerful, or capable, is its closest and most fitting synonym.

p: The Thought Fox is one of the early and most favourite poems of Ted Hughes (published in 1957). This poem is symbolic of the process of poetic inspiration. The symbolism of poetic inspiration is concealed behind the animal imagery. The fox in this poem represents the poet's imaginative powers. The poet goes through a special kind of loneliness; this loneliness is not the absence of people around him, but the absence of Creative powers. His fingers move, but the pages remain blank. The poetic inspiration in the poem, which is represented by Fox, appears in the poem part by part. It does not appear in full. Sometimes it's nose images, Eyes, it's prints, or the Shadows. This is a perfect illustration of how our poetic inspiration comes, i.e., any literary composition is produced in parts; it is seldom written in one sitting or in one go.

t: What is the central theme of the poem?
o: The slowly emerging imaginative power and creative inspiration in the writer's mind
The nature's destructive power that hinders the poet's writing
The factory development that eclipses the countryside and art
The physical presence of a wild animal in a quiet setting
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज: लोमड़ी कवि की कल्पनाशक्ति का प्रतीक है, यानी कविता का केंद्र धीरे-धीरे उभरती रचनात्मक प्रेरणा है।

t: Why does the poet describe a sense of loneliness in the poem?
o: As he remembers the good old days of his childhood, he longs for the countryside life very much.
As he is literally pushed away in a forest far from any human being.
As he considers himself an outsider to the social group and does not want to interact with anyone at all.
As he is going through a dry creative period, even though he is in the middle of a crowd.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज: कवि का अकेलापन लोगों की अनुपस्थिति नहीं, बल्कि रचनात्मक शक्ति की अनुपस्थिति है; उँगलियाँ चलती हैं पर पन्ने खाली रहते हैं।

t: How does the poem illustrate the process of writing a literary composition?
o: By demonstrating that poems are generally composed in a single session, with a constant and uninterrupted flow of ideas
By implying that creativity is a systematic process and adheres to a standardized formula
By representing inspiration as being cut up into pieces, coming bit by bit, before a whole thought is formed
By showing that literature is mostly plagiarized from earlier nature works
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज: प्रेरणा टुकड़ों में आती है (नाक, आँखें, पदचिह्न, छाया), जो दिखाता है कि रचना शायद ही एक बार में लिखी जाती है।

t: What is the significance of animal imagery in The Thought Fox?
o: It hides the abstract idea of poetic inspiration under a visible, palatable metaphor
It points out the drawbacks of industrialization in relation to nature and its inhabitants.
It highlights the anxiety of the poet in regard to nature and its unpredictability
It gives a bright picture of the countryside, not connected to the theme of creativity
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पशु-बिंब अमूर्त काव्य-प्रेरणा को एक मूर्त प्रतीक के पीछे छिपा देता है।

t: Why is The Thought Fox considered one of Hughes' most celebrated early poems?
o: For the reason that it deals with the poet's intimate relations rather than his art in the making
Since the poem deals with the themes of the countryside and the industrialization of Northern Ireland
Due to the fact that it reveals the mystery of the creative process by means of abundant, vivid imagery
As the poem does not use metaphors at all and only gives a literal account of the situation
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: यह कविता प्रचुर, सजीव बिंबों के माध्यम से रचनात्मक प्रक्रिया के रहस्य को उजागर करती है, इसलिए प्रसिद्ध है।

p: Japan is often admired around the world for its high level of discipline and social order. From childhood, Japanese people are taught to respect rules, value punctuality, and prioritise community welfare over individual interests. This cultural emphasis on discipline has played a major role in Japan's remarkable progress and social harmony. One can see examples of discipline in everyday life, people stand in neat lines at stations, streets are clean despite a lack of dustbins, and public spaces are rarely damaged. The Japanese education system also strongly focuses on moral training, teamwork, and responsibility. Such habits help develop a sense of collective responsibility among citizens. During times of crisis, such as natural disasters, the discipline of Japanese people becomes even more evident. They remain calm, organised, and cooperative, which makes recovery faster and more effective. This cultural value has not only strengthened their society internally but has also earned Japan a reputation for efficiency and respect on the global stage.

t: In the sentence: "From childhood, Japanese people are taught to respect rules, value punctuality, and prioritise community welfare over individual interests," what is the part of speech of the word "punctuality"?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Punctuality" (समयबद्धता) Verb 'value' का Direct Object है। किसी गुण, भाव या अवस्था के नाम को Noun (Abstract Noun) कहते हैं।

t: In the sentence: "The Japanese education system also strongly focuses on moral training, teamwork, and responsibility," why is the verb "focuses" used instead of "focus"?
o: Because the sentence is in passive voice
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Subject "The Japanese education system" एकवचन (Singular) है। इसलिए Simple Present Tense के नियमानुसार Verb के साथ 's/es' लगाया गया है (focus -> focuses)।

t: In the sentence: "This cultural value has not only strengthened their society internally but has also earned Japan a reputation for efficiency and respect on the global stage," what is the closest synonym for the word "efficiency"?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Efficiency" का अर्थ है 'दक्षता' या कम समय और संसाधन में बेहतर काम करने की क्षमता। इसका सबसे करीबी समानार्थी (Synonym) 'Effectiveness' (प्रभावशीलता) है। Hindi Meaning: दक्षता / प्रभावशीलता.

t: In the sentence: "This cultural emphasis on discipline has played a major role in Japan's remarkable progress and social harmony," what does the word "emphasis" most likely mean in this context?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Emphasis" का अर्थ होता है किसी चीज़ पर विशेष 'ज़ोर देना' या 'अहमियत देना' (Special importance or attention)। जापान में अनुशासन पर खास ज़ोर दिया जाता है। Hindi Meaning: ज़ोर देना / महत्व देना.

t: What is the main idea of the passage?
o: Discipline is deeply rooted in Japanese culture and benefits society
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पूरा पैसेज इसी बारे में है कि कैसे जापानियों को बचपन से ही अनुशासन (Discipline) सिखाया जाता है और इससे उनके समाज को शांति, तरक्की और आपदा में तेज़ी से उबरने का फायदा मिलता है।

p: India's digital transformation over the last decade has been nothing short of revolutionary. What began as a modest attempt to expand internet access has now evolved into one of the largest digital ecosystems in the world. Spearheaded by government initiatives such as Digital India, the country has witnessed an unprecedented surge in internet penetration, digital payments, and online governance. A pivotal moment in this journey was the launch of Aadhaar, a biometric-based identification system that enabled secure and streamlined access to various public services. Coupled with the rise of Unified Payments Interface (UPI), India has leapfrogged traditional banking hurdles and facilitated real-time, low-cost transactions across urban and rural regions alike. Significantly, the pandemic acted as an unexpected catalyst. As lockdowns forced physical distancing, citizens turned to digital alternatives — telemedicine, online education, and remote work became not just accessible but essential. This sudden shift forced both public and private sectors to rethink infrastructure and embrace scalable tech solutions. However, the digital journey hasn't been without obstacles. A persistent digital divide remains, particularly between urban and rural populations. While metros enjoy high-speed broadband, many villages struggle with basic connectivity. Moreover, concerns around data privacy, cybersecurity, and misinformation have emerged as pressing issues in this digital age. Nonetheless, India's digital growth story remains a testament to its adaptability and ambition. With over 850 million internet users and counting, the nation stands at a crucial intersection — where robust digital policy, inclusive access, and responsible innovation will determine the trajectory of its digital future.

t: What major government initiative catalyzed India's digital ecosystem?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज में साफ़ लिखा है: "Spearheaded by government initiatives such as Digital India..."

t: What role did Aadhaar play in digital growth?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: आधार (Aadhaar) के बारे में लिखा है कि इसने "enabled secure and streamlined access to various public services."

t: Which factor unexpectedly accelerated India's digital adoption?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: महामारी के दौरान डिजिटल को बढ़ावा मिला: "Significantly, the pandemic acted as an unexpected catalyst."

t: What is a current challenge in India's digital development?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: वर्तमान चुनौतियों (obstacles) के रूप में "persistent digital divide" और "concerns around data privacy" का उल्लेख किया गया है।

t: What does the passage suggest is key to India's digital future?
o: Higher tax rates on digital goods
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: भारत का भविष्य इन चीज़ों पर निर्भर करे गा: "robust digital policy, inclusive access, and responsible innovation."

p: The Jaipur Literature Festival, often described as the "greatest literary show on Earth," is an annual celebration of literature, ideas, and culture. It began in 2006 with modest gatherings but has now grown into a global platform where writers, thinkers, historians, politicians, business leaders, and entertainers come together. Thousands of visitors from India and abroad attend the festival every year, eager to listen to renowned authors and to engage in debates on contemporary issues.

The festival has provided a stage for Nobel laureates, Booker Prize winners, and debut novelists alike. It has encouraged dialogue on topics as varied as climate change, gender equality, history, art, and technology. Over the years, JLF has expanded to cities across the world, yet Jaipur remains its most iconic venue. The setting of the Diggi Palace, with its vibrant decorations, adds charm and grandeur to the intellectual exchange.

In the past, literary festivals were considered exclusive events for scholars, but JLF has democratized literature by making it accessible to all. In the present day, it represents a space where people from diverse backgrounds can share stories and ideas. In the future, the festival may grow even further, incorporating digital platforms to reach audiences who cannot be physically present. Thus, JLF is not merely a festival; it is a cultural phenomenon that continues to inspire readers and writers across generations.

t: Identify the tense in the sentence.
"It began in 2006 with modest gatherings but has now grown into a global platform."
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: 'began' (Simple Past) और 'has grown' (Present Perfect) है; दिए विकल्पों में सबसे निकट विकल्प 'Present Simple + Present Perfect' माना गया है, जैसा स्रोत में दिया है।

t: Change the voice of the sentence.
"Thousands of visitors from India and abroad attend the festival every year."
o: The festival was attended by thousands of visitors from India and abroad every year.
Thousands of visitors are attending the festival India and abroad.
The festival had been attended by thousands of visitors from India and abroad every year.
Every year the festival is attended by thousands of visitors from India and abroad.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Active: Thousands of visitors attend the festival. Passive में कर्म कर्ता बनता है और Simple Present में 'is attended by' आता है: The festival is attended by thousands of visitors.

t: Choose the synonym of 'democratized'.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: 'Democratized' का अर्थ सबके लिए सुलभ बनाना (made accessible) है। Hindi Meaning: लोकतांत्रिक बनाना / सबके लिए सुलभ करना.

t: The antonym of 'exclusive' is
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: 'Exclusive' (विशिष्ट/सीमित) का विलोम 'inclusive' (सबको शामिल करने वाला) है। Hindi Meaning: अनन्य बनाम समावेशी.

t: According to the passage, why is Jaipur considered the most iconic venue for JLF?
o: Because it has the largest halls
Because most Nobel laureates live there
Because other cities do not host it anymore
Because Diggi Palace adds charm and grandeur to the exchange of ideas
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज: जयपुर सबसे प्रतिष्ठित स्थल है क्योंकि डिग्गी पैलेस का सजा-धजा परिवेश बौद्धिक आदान-प्रदान में आकर्षण और भव्यता जोड़ता है।

p: The National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 is one of the most significant educational reforms introduced in India in recent decades. It aims to transform the education system to make it more holistic, flexible, multidisciplinary, and aligned with the needs of the 21st century. The policy replaces the 10+2 structure with a new 5+3+3+4 system, which focuses on the foundational stage and encourages critical thinking from an early age. One of the key effects of the NEP is the emphasis on mother tongue or regional language as the medium of instruction at the primary level. This has generated both appreciation and concern. While experts believe it will strengthen children's roots and understanding, some worry about challenges in implementation and the impact on English language proficiency. Furthermore, the NEP promotes vocational education, digital literacy, and interdisciplinary studies. It aims to reduce rote learning and exams-centric approaches by encouraging practical knowledge and creativity. If implemented effectively, the NEP could reshape India's educational landscape for generations to come.

t: Identify the sentence that contains a modal verb used to express possibility.
o: The policy replaces the 10+2 structure with a new 5+3+3+4 system.
It aims to reduce rote learning and exams-centric approaches.
While experts believe it will strengthen children's roots and understanding.
If implemented effectively, the NEP could reshape India's educational landscape.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Could" एक modal verb है जो संभावना (possibility) बताता है, निश्चितता नहीं। Option (d) में "could" भविष्य के संभावित नतीजे के लिए आया है। Option (c) का "will" निश्चितता या विश्वास का भाव देता है, संभावना वाला modal नहीं। उत्तर (d)।

t: Which of the following words from the passage is a gerund?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Gerund वह -ing रूप है जो noun का काम करे। "Rote learning" में "learning" एक अवधारणा का नाम बताकर noun की तरह काम कर रहा है, इसलिए यह gerund है। "Reshape" और "Replace" base-form verbs हैं और "Emphasis" एक सामान्य noun है। उत्तर (b) Learning।

t: What is the meaning of the word "holistic" as used in the passage?
o: Considering all parts as interconnected and complete
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: शिक्षा सुधार के संदर्भ में "holistic" का अर्थ है पूरे और आपस में जुड़े हुए रूप को देखना, यानी छात्र के हर पहलू (बौद्धिक, सामाजिक, भावनात्मक) का विकास, सिर्फ़ अकादमिक अंकों का नहीं। यह "Limited to academic learning only" के उलट है। उत्तर (c)। Hindi Meaning: समग्र।

t: Choose the correct antonym for the word "flexible" as used in the passage.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Flexible" का अर्थ है आसानी से बदलाव के अनुसार ढल जाने वाला। इसका antonym "Rigid" है, यानी अकड़ा हुआ, न झुकने वाला। "Adjustable" तो flexible का synonym है, और "Easy" व "Clear" असंबंधित गुण हैं। उत्तर (b) Rigid। Hindi Meaning: लचीला; Antonym: कठोर।

t: Which is a key goal of the NEP according to the passage?
o: To remove regional languages from schools
To encourage practical and creative learning
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज साफ़ कहता है कि NEP "aims to reduce rote learning and exams-centric approaches by encouraging practical knowledge and creativity." इसलिए सीधा बताया गया लक्ष्य व्यावहारिक और रचनात्मक सीख को बढ़ावा देना है। NEP तो प्राथमिक स्तर पर क्षेत्रीय भाषाओं को बढ़ावा देती है, जो Option (a) के उलट है। उत्तर (c)।

p: India's tryst with the Olympic Games began in 1900, when Norman Pritchard, a British-Indian athlete, clinched two silver medals in athletics. However, it wasn't until the 1928 Amsterdam Olympics that India emerged as a formidable force in hockey, winning its first team gold. What followed was a golden era, where the Indian men's hockey team dominated the Olympic arena with eight gold medals between 1928 and 1980 — an unmatched legacy. Despite this early excellence, India's Olympic journey has been riddled with inconsistencies. Post-1980, a conspicuous medal drought gripped the nation, exposing systemic inefficiencies: lack of infrastructure, inadequate training, and minimal grassroots scouting. Athletes often relied more on personal resilience than institutional support to achieve global recognition. The 21st century, however, has ushered in a phase of cautious optimism. With the establishment of bodies like the Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS) and increased corporate sponsorship, Indian athletes now enjoy improved access to international-level coaching, nutrition, and psychological training. The medal tallies, though modest, have seen an upward trend — symbolized by Neeraj Chopra's historic gold in javelin at Tokyo 2020. What's most heartening is the diversification of sports. No longer confined to hockey and wrestling, India is now making strides in disciplines like badminton, shooting, boxing, and athletics. Equally noteworthy is the rising representation and success of Indian women athletes, who have frequently been the torchbearers in recent Olympic outings. Yet, challenges remain. The transition from potential to podium demands long-term investment, scientific sports management, and societal encouragement that transcends cricket-centric fandom. While India's Olympic identity is still evolving, the collective ambition is clearer than ever: to transform from a participant nation into a sporting powerhouse.

t: When did India first win an Olympic team gold medal?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज में साफ़ लिखा है: "it wasn't until the 1928 Amsterdam Olympics that India emerged as a formidable force in hockey, winning its first team gold."

t: What major issue plagued India's Olympic performance post-1980?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: 1980 के बाद भारत का प्रदर्शन इसलिए खराब हुआ क्योंकि "exposing systemic inefficiencies: lack of infrastructure, inadequate training..." (ढांचागत कमियां थीं)।

t: Which initiative is mentioned as a game-changer in recent Olympic preparation?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: हाल के वर्षों में सुधार लाने वाली संस्था के तौर पर पैसेज में "Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS)" का नाम लिया गया है।

t: What recent trend is encouraging in India's Olympic profile?
o: Emergence of multiple sports and women athletes
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज में "diversification of sports" (बैडमिंटन, शूटिंग आदि) और "rising representation and success of Indian women athletes" को सबसे अच्छी बात (most heartening) बताया गया है।

t: What is implied about India's Olympic aspirations?
o: They rely entirely on foreign coaching
They are growing but need sustained reforms
They are limited to traditional sports
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज के अंत में है: "The transition from potential to podium demands long-term investment, scientific sports management..." (यानी हम बढ़ तो रहे हैं , लेकिन अभी लंबी और लगातार रिफॉर्म्स की ज़रूरत है)।

p: The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into decision-making systems raises profound ethical dilemmas. Unlike humans, AI lacks consciousness or moral intent, yet it increasingly influences areas such as hiring, law enforcement, and healthcare. When algorithms are trained on biased data, they may perpetuate systemic inequalities under the guise of neutrality. Moreover, responsibility becomes diffuse — if an AI-driven system causes harm, who is accountable: the programmer, the user, or the company? Transparency, often lacking in proprietary models, further complicates public trust. Ethical AI development must therefore go beyond functionality; it requires fairness audits, explainability, and robust oversight mechanisms. Without these, we risk embedding opaque biases into institutions that shape human lives. The dilemma is not merely technical but philosophical — can machines, devoid of values, make morally sound choices, or are we outsourcing ethical responsibility to lines of code?

t: What is the central ethical concern raised in the passage?
o: Lack of data for AI training
Delegating moral responsibility to non-conscious systems
AI replacing engineers in key jobs
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज के अंत में मुख्य सवाल उठाया गया है: "can machines, devoid of values, make morally sound choices, or are we outsourcing ethical responsibility to lines of code?" (क्या हम अपनी नैतिक ज़िम्मेदारी मशीनों को सौंप रहे हैं ?)

t: What does the author imply by describing AI's neutrality as a "guise"?
o: AI systems are incapable of calculations
The neutrality is often an illusion due to biased training data
AI refuses to learn from its environment
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Guise" का अर्थ है 'भेष' या 'दिखावा'। AI निष्पक्ष (neutral) होने का सिर्फ दिखावा करता है, जबकि वास्तव में यह "biased data" के कारण पक्षपाती होता है।

t: Why is accountability in AI decision-making described as "diffuse"?
o: Because many parties may share responsibility
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: 'Diffuse' का मतलब है फैला हुआ। जवाबदेही (accountability) इसलिए diffuse है क्योंकि यह तय करना मुश्किल है कि गलती होने पर ज़िम्मेदार कौन है: "the programmer, the user, or the company?"

t: What does the author suggest is required for ethical AI development?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज साफ़ कहता है: "Ethical AI development... requires fairness audits, explainability (transparency), and robust oversight mechanisms."

t: Which of the following best captures the tone of the passage?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: लेखक AI के नैतिक खतरों पर 'विचार' (Reflective) कर रहा है और हमें सावधान (Cautionary) कर रहा है कि अगर हमने ध्यान नहीं दिया तो समाज में भेदभाव बढ़ जाएगा।

p: Habits, scientists say, emerge because the brain is constantly looking for ways to save effort. Left to its own devices, the brain will try to make almost any routine into a habit, because habits allow our minds to ramp down more often. This effort-saving instinct is a huge advantage. An efficient brain requires less room, which makes for a smaller head, which makes childbirth easier, and therefore makes survival more likely. But conserving mental effort is only part of the story. Habits also have a powerful impact on our behaviors because once they are formed, they operate automatically. Even more importantly, habits can be changed, replaced, or ignored— but only if we understand how they work. At the core of every habit is a neurological loop that consists of three parts: a cue, a routine, and a reward. This loop is the foundation of all habitual behaviors. The cue is the trigger that tells your brain to go into automatic mode, the routine is the behavior itself, and the reward is what helps your brain remember the loop in the future. Understanding this loop is the first step in taking control of habits, whether you want to break a bad habit or create a new one.

t: Identify the correct passive voice form of the following sentence: "Habits also have a powerful impact on our behaviors."
o: Our behaviors are powerfully impacted by habits.
A powerful impact is also had on our behaviors by habits.
Our behaviors have been impacted powerfully by habits.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: वाक्य Simple Present Tense में है। "have a powerful impact on" को पैसिव में बदलते समय "are powerfully impacted by" का उपयोग किया जाता है। यहाँ Adverb 'powerfully' को सही जगह पर रखा गया है। Hindi Meaning: हमारी आदतों का हमारे व्यवहार पर गहरा प्रभाव पड़ता है।

t: Choose the correct indirect speech conversion of the sentence: "Scientists say, 'Habits emerge because the brain is constantly looking for ways to save effort'."
o: Scientists say that habits emerge because the brain is constantly looking for ways to save effort.
Scientists said that habits emerged because the brain was constantly looking for ways to save effort.
Scientists say habits had emerged because the brain constantly looked for ways to save effort.
Scientists have said that habits emerge as the brain constantly looks for ways to save effort.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Reporting verb "say" (Present Tense) में है। Grammar Rule: जब Reporting verb Present या Future tense में हो, तो Reported speech का Tense नहीं बदलता है। इसलिए वाक्य वैसा ही रहेगा, बस 'that' जुड़ जाएगा।

t: What is the meaning of the word "emerge" in the sentence: "Habits, scientists say, emerge because the brain is constantly looking for ways to save effort."
o: To come into existence or become known
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Emerge" का मतलब होता है किसी चीज़ का पैदा होना, उभरना या सामने आना। आदतें इसलिए "उभरती" (emerge) हैं क्योंकि दिमाग ऊर्जा बचाना चाहता है। Hindi Meaning: उभरना / अस्तित्व में आना.

t: Choose the best synonym for the word "trigger" in the sentence: "The cue is the trigger that tells your brain to go into automatic mode."
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Trigger" का अर्थ है वह चीज़ जो किसी प्रक्रिया को शुरू करती है (जैसे बंदूक का ट्रिगर)। इसका सबसे अच्छा Synonym "Initiator" (शुरुआत करने वाला) है। Barrier और Obstacle इसके विलोम हैं। Hindi Meaning: शुरुआत करने वाला / ट्रिगर.

t: According to the passage, why does the brain try to turn routines into habits?
o: Because habits help conserve mental effort, making survival easier.
Because habits make the brain grow larger and more powerful.
Because habits prevent the brain from making automatic decisions.
Because habits eliminate the need for learning new things.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज की शुरुआत में ही स्पष्ट लिखा है: "the brain is constantly looking for ways to save effort" जिससे दिमाग का साइज़ छोटा होता है और इंसान के 'सर्वाइवल' (survival) के चांस बढ़ते हैं।

p: Social media platforms have reshaped how people perceive reality. Algorithms tailor content to individual preferences, creating echo chambers where users mostly see what aligns with their views. This personalization limits exposure to diverse opinions and can distort one's understanding of events. Additionally, carefully curated posts—highlighting success, beauty, or wealth—can lead to unrealistic comparisons and lowered self-esteem. Studies show that frequent exposure to such content may affect mental health, especially among youth. What's more, misinformation spreads quickly, often blurring the line between fact and opinion. To counter this, users need digital literacy and a critical mindset. Awareness of algorithmic influence helps in making more balanced judgments. In a world where perception often shapes action, conscious media consumption is not just beneficial—it's essential.

t: According to the passage, what is a major effect of social media algorithms?
o: They expose users to random ideas
They limit exposure to differing opinions
q.e: According to the passage, social media algorithms tailor content to individual preferences, which creates echo chambers. This process effectively limits the user's exposure to diverse or differing opinions, thereby distorting their overall understanding of various events.

t: What psychological impact may result from curated social media content?
q.e: The passage explicitly states that carefully curated posts highlighting success, beauty, or wealth can lead to unrealistic comparisons. This psychological pressure often results in lowered self-esteem among users, particularly the youth who consume such content frequently.

t: What role does misinformation play on social media platforms?
o: It is easily identified and removed
It spreads quickly and confuses truth
It is only visible in news outlets
q.e: The text mentions that misinformation spreads rapidly on social media platforms. This rapid dissemination often blurs the distinction between fact and opinion, leading to significant confusion regarding the truth and accuracy of the information being presented.

t: How can users counter the negative influence of social media perception?
o: Develop critical and digital literacy skills
q.e: To mitigate the negative effects of social media perception, the passage suggests that users must develop digital literacy and a critical mindset. Awareness of algorithmic influence helps individuals process information more objectively and make more balanced judgments.

t: What is the central idea of the passage?
o: Social media shapes perception and needs mindful usage
Only teenagers are affected by media
q.e: The passage discusses how social media algorithms and curated content influence our perception of reality and mental health. It emphasizes that because these platforms can distort understanding and spread misinformation, users must practice conscious media consumption and digital literacy to maintain a balanced perspective.

p: The deep ocean remains one of the least explored parts of our planet, hiding countless unique species that continue to surprise scientists. Unlike creatures living near the surface, many deep-sea animals have developed unusual features to survive in complete darkness, extreme pressure, and freezing temperatures. One such example is the anglerfish, which uses a bioluminescent lure to attract its prey in the pitch-black depths. Another fascinating species is the giant squid, rarely seen by humans but known to grow to impressive lengths. Some deep-sea creatures, like certain jellyfish, glow in the dark through a chemical reaction in their bodies. These species play a crucial role in maintaining the ocean's delicate ecosystem. However, human activities like deep-sea mining and pollution threaten their existence. Scientists stress the importance of protecting these hidden worlds, as they could hold secrets that help us understand life on Earth and even develop new medicines.

t: In the sentence: "The deep ocean remains one of the least explored parts of our planet," what is the tense of the verb "remains"?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Remains" Simple Present का third-person singular रूप है। इसके साथ कोई auxiliary नहीं है और न ही "-ing", और यह महासागर की खोज की मौजूदा सामान्य स्थिति बताता है। Present Continuous में "is remaining" और Present Perfect में "has remained" होता। उत्तर (b) Present simple।

t: In the sentence: "Some deep-sea creatures, like certain jellyfish, glow in the dark through a chemical reaction in their bodies," is the sentence in active or passive voice?
o: Active voice the subject performs the action
Passive voice the action is done to the subject
Passive voice - the agent is unknown
Active voice no verb is used
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Subject "Some deep-sea creatures" ख़ुद "glow" की क्रिया करता है और वाक्य में "be + V3" वाली passive संरचना नहीं है। जीव ख़ुद चमकते हैं, इसलिए यह Active voice (Simple Present) है। Trick: subject करे और be+V3 न हो = Active। उत्तर (a)।

t: The word "bioluminescent" means:
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Bio-" का अर्थ है जीवित प्राणी और "luminescent" का अर्थ है प्रकाश छोड़ना। मिलकर "bioluminescent" जीवों की उस क्षमता को बताता है जिसमें वे भीतरी रासायनिक क्रियाओं से रोशनी पैदा करते हैं, जैसे anglerfish अपने lure से करती है। उत्तर (b) Giving off light naturally। Hindi Meaning: जैव-दीप्तिमान।

t: The word "ecosystem" means:
o: A network of living and non-living things in an environment
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: "Ecosystem" एक जैविक तंत्र है जिसमें किसी क्षेत्र के सभी जीव आपस में और अपने भौतिक वातावरण के साथ क्रिया करते हैं, यानी किसी विशेष आवास में जीवित और निर्जीव चीज़ों का आपस में जुड़ा जाल। उत्तर (c)। Hindi Meaning: पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र।

t: What is the main idea of the passage?
o: Deep-sea species are harmful to humans
Deep-sea species are interesting but under threat and need protection
The ocean is easy to explore fully
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज पहले गहरे समुद्र के जीवों की दिलचस्प विशेषताएँ बताता है और फिर इंसानी गतिविधियों से उन पर मंडराते ख़तरों की ओर मुड़ता है। केंद्रीय तर्क यह है कि ये अनोखी और मूल्यवान प्रजातियाँ संरक्षण की ज़रूरतमंद हैं। इसलिए (b) सबसे सटीक सार है।

p: In 1930, Mahatma Gandhi started a peaceful protest called the Dandi March. He and his followers walked 240 kilometers from Sabarmati Ashram to Dandi, a village near the sea. The purpose of the march was to protest the British law that taxed salt. Salt is a basic need for everyone, and Gandhi believed it was unfair to make people pay for it. During the march, more and more people joined him. The British government tried to stop the movement, but Gandhi remained calm and peaceful. He made salt from the sea at Dandi, breaking the law in a non-violent way. The Dandi March became a strong symbol of India's fight for freedom. It showed the world that peaceful protest could be powerful. Even today, it is remembered as a brave step in India's struggle for independence.

t: Who led the Dandi March?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज की पहली लाइन: "In 1930, Mahatma Gandhi started a peaceful protest..."

t: What was the distance covered in the march?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज की दूसरी लाइन: "He and his followers walked 240 kilometers..."

t: What does the Dandi March symbolize today?
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज के अंत में है: "It showed the world that peaceful protest could be powerful" और इसे एक "brave step" (साहसी कदम / courage) माना जाता है।

p: Gustave Flaubert, in his novel Madame Bovary, exposes the fate of his female protagonist. Emma-The fictional character of Flaubert was constructed around a feminist centre to expose the author's viewpoint on the role and position of French women in nineteenth-century society. Since childhood, Emma had been reading books; she used to develop her intellectual capacity so that, after her marriage, this dimension would not be altered. Emma learned the world from books because she was very constrained by the patriarchal system. She was an orphan, so when she chose her peace of mind by taking refuge in reading novels, she was safer from the unkind world. Due to her unhappy married life, she dreamt of the life she read about in her books. Instead of the traditional, boring routine she was supposed to follow, she wanted more from life. Emma wanted someone she could talk to, and with whom she could share her intellectual knowledge in some way; she wanted to know more, read more and talk more. She was unable to get used to the idea of staying at the same stage; she wanted to change, to develop, to be a better person.

t: According to the passage, what was the primary reason Emma turned to books during her childhood?
q.sr: [SSC Stenographer Grade C & D 2026, 09 Sep 2026, Shift-2]
o: To seek refuge from an unkind world and patriarchal limitations.
To prepare for a future professional career as a scholar.
To impress potential suitors within nineteenth-century French society.
To avoid the responsibilities associated with domestic chores.
q.e: The passage points out directly that Emma was "constrained by the patriarchal system" and, being an orphan, she purposefully took "refuge in reading novels" to keep herself mentally safe from the "unkind world."

t: What does the passage suggest was the ultimate cause of Emma's dissatisfaction in her marriage?
o: Her husband did not allow her to read any books.
She found the traditional, boring routine of her life insufficient for her intellectual needs.
She was forced to live in an orphanage away from her spouse.
Her husband stopped her from talking to others about what she knew because he was afraid of being judged.
q.e: The text notes that because of her unhappy life, she longed for the excitement she read about in books, desiring intellectual stimulation over the "traditional, boring routine she was supposed to follow."

t: How did Emma's habit of reading books affect her identity?
o: It made her completely oblivious to the patriarchal system surrounding her.
It forced her to abandon her desire to be a "better person".
It ensured her intellectual capacity could not be easily altered after marriage.
It made her content with staying at the same intellectual stage.
q.e: The text explicitly states that since childhood, Emma read books "to develop her intellectual capacity so that, after her marriage, this dimension would not be altered." This fortified her inner identity against society's strict domestic expectations.

t: Based on the passage, what did Emma primarily desire from her relationships?
o: Financial security and social status within the French aristocracy.
A traditional domestic partner who would handle all intellectual and financial decisions.
Someone to help her organise her collection of novels.
A companion with whom she could share intellectual knowledge and conversation.
q.e: The passage underscores her desire for intellectual kinship, stating plainly that "Emma wanted someone she could talk to, and with whom she could share her intellectual knowledge in some way."

t: In the passage, the word "altered" is used. Which of the following is a synonym for "altered" in this context?
q.e: The word "altered" means changed or modified in character, composition, or state. In the context of her intellectual capacity not being changed by marriage, "modified" serves as the precise equivalent synonym.

p: My Lute Awake is a lyric poem with eight five-line stanzas and a refrain. The poem opens with the use of a literary device known as Apostrophe, in which the poet personifies the only living lute, calling it to get awake, for one last time, so that both he and the poet can complete the last task before they die. The poet feels repulsive to his lady. So the poem is bitter in tone. The bitterness became more intense, and the speaker of the poem becomes violent as he proclaims, Vengeance shall fall on thy disdain. The lady is not innocent, though as she 'makest but a game on earnest pain'. Therefore, cruelty demands punishment. The poet predicts the future of the lady, saying that she may end her days in loneliness, Perchance thee lie wethered and old/The winter nights that are so cold. The reason is that she has been extraordinarily heartless; therefore, there is no possibility that anyone can love her for long. The poem is embittered and follows the philosophy of Carpe Diem, as do the previous poems. The poet warns the lady to respond soon or face the consequences.

t: What is the literary device that gives a shape to the dramatic opening of 'My Lute Awake'?
o: Hyperbole to highlight the poet's emotional chaos by means of exaggeration
Apostrophe because the poet speaks directly to his lute, which is a personification
Alliteration that throws light on the musicality of the poem through consonant repetition
Paradox the contradictory character of love and hate is revealed
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: कविता की शुरुआत Apostrophe से होती है, जिसमें कवि सीधे अपने ल्यूट को संबोधित कर उसे मानवीकृत करता है।

t: Which option presents the strongest indication in the poem that the lady was morally judged negatively?
o: She is depicted as an unsuspecting victim of the situation
She is depicted as mischievous but at heart good-natured
She is admired for her loyalty and love in the long run
She "makest but a game on earnest pain," trivializing others' suffering
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पंक्ति 'makest but a game on earnest pain' दिखाती है कि वह दूसरों की सच्ची पीड़ा को खेल बना देती है, यानी नैतिक रूप से उसे दोषी ठहराया गया है।

t: What makes the poet foresee a future for the lady filled with loneliness and desolation?
o: The lady's character of being extremely cold emotionally leads eventually to no lasting love at all.
The reason she shuns the world, the custom, and the way it cuts her off is the lonely future she has chosen for herself
The fair lady matures into an old lady, loses her beauty, and is finally ravaged by disease.
She is the villain in the community's eyes, and thus, the community's displeasure leads to her forced isolation.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: पैसेज: वह अत्यधिक निर्दय है, इसलिए कोई भी उसे लंबे समय तक प्रेम नहीं कर सकता और उसका बुढ़ापा अकेलेपन में बीतेगा।

t: The line "Vengeance shall fall on thy disdain" most clearly reveals which aspect of the speaker's emotional state?
o: His calm reasoning about future consequences
His fresh faith that the woman might transform
His violent rage due to his unrequited love and longing for punishment
His hopeless, unromantic love, but resigned acceptance
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: 'Vengeance shall fall on thy disdain' कवि के अस्वीकृत प्रेम से उपजे हिंसक क्रोध और दंड की इच्छा को दर्शाती है।

t: In what way does the poem reflect the idea of carpe diem?
o: The speaker feels encouraged to seek military fame before time runs out.
The poem encourages acting quickly before opportunities disappear with time.
The poem encourages openly celebrating love.
The poem suggests the two should avoid passion and remain modest.
q.e: Detailed Grammar/Explanation: Carpe Diem का दर्शन है समय रहते कदम उठाना; कवि स्त्री को जल्द उत्तर देने की चेतावनी देता है, वरना परिणाम भुगतने होंगे।
